DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:People Manager, MEP Design

Position Location:Remote -workvirtually fromanywhere in the United States

SALARY

DLB recognizes salary ranges from jobboardsdo not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

JOB SUMMARY

The People Manager, MEP Design is a senior-level people leader responsible for the day-to-day management, development, and engagement of a cross-discipline MEP design team. This fully remote role spans entry-level employees and those at the levelimmediatelyabove, with a clear mandate to grow early-career talent and build a high-performing, cohesive team across mechanical, electrical, and plumbing disciplines.

The ideal candidate brings a substantive MEP technical background that allows them to credibly support, guide, and evaluate the work of their team without being a practitioner themselves. They arefirst and foremosta people leader: someone who creates clarity, removes obstacles, and invests in the professional growth of those they manage. They are equally comfortable working asynchronously across time zones and proactively building the kind of team culture that thrives without daily in-person contact.

This personoperateswith significant autonomy, self-directs their day-to-day priorities, and leads multiple concurrentpeoplemanagement and team development workstreams of meaningful complexity. They develop andmaintainteam standards, workflows, and onboarding practices, and serve as a key voice in shaping howDLB'sDesign department scales its early-career talent pipeline.

The People Manager, MEPDesignwill communicate andoperatein alignment withDLB'sorganizational goals and values, as well as departmentalobjectivesset by Design leadership.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Team Leadership & People Development(40%)

  • Provide direct day-to-day people management for a cross-discipline MEP design team spanning entry-level employees and those at the levelimmediatelyabove
  • Establish andmaintaina strong remote team culture grounded in accountability, psychological safety, and consistent communication ensuring team members feel connected and supported despite geographic distance
  • Develop individualized growth plans for each direct report, with particular emphasis on accelerating the development of entry-level employees into higher levels of independent contribution
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings with all direct reports;maintaina consistent cadence of structured check-ins, feedback conversations, and goal reviews throughout the year
  • Serve as a primary advocate and resource for team members navigating DLB systems, processes, tools, and culture; activelyconnectpeople to the support and information they need
  • Model DLB values and operating norms in all interactions; actively reinforce the behaviors and standards that reflect the DLB way of working

Performance Management & Coaching (25%)

  • Lead all performance review cycles for direct reports, includinggoal-setting, mid-year check-ins, and annual evaluations; provide substantive, actionable feedback grounded in observed behavior and outcomes
  • Identifyperformance concerns early; address them directly and constructively through coaching, clear expectation-setting, and documented follow-up; escalate to HR or department leadership when appropriate
  • Leverage MEP technical background to evaluate the quality and appropriateness of direct reports' work product;providetechnically credible guidance without taking on a practitioner role
  • Recognize and celebratestrong performance; ensure high contributors feel seen and are positioned for advancement in line with DLB career pathways
  • Proactivelyidentifysignals of disengagement, burnout, or unmet development needs; address them with empathy andappropriate urgencybefore they escalate

Workflow Coordination & Project Oversight(20%)

  • Monitor team workload distribution across cross-discipline MEP assignments; surface capacity constraints and coordinate with project leads and department leadership to ensure balanced, sustainable allocation
  • Establish andmaintainteam-level workflows, communication norms, and operating practices that support consistent quality andtimelydelivery in a fully remote environment
  • Identifyand remove process barriers that impede team productivity; escalate systemic issues to department or operations leadership with clear context and recommended solutions
  • Own and continuously refine onboarding practices for new team members, ensuring entry-level employees are set up for early success with clear expectations, resources, and a supported ramp period

Cross-functional & Departmental Collaboration (10%)

  • Partner with HR and People Development on talent strategy for the MEP Design team, including hiring, succession planning, and early-career pipeline development
  • Collaboratewith other Design department managers and discipline leads tosharebest practices,align oncross-team norms, andsupporta consistent DLB employee experience regardless of location
  • Participate in department-level planning conversations, providing the perspective of a front-line people manager with a cross-discipline MEP team;representthe needs, challenges, and development trajectories of direct reports

Administrative (5%)

  • Maintainaccurateand up-to-date records related to team headcount, performance documentation, and development plans; ensuretimelycompletion of HR-required processes and reporting

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS(ADVANCEDLEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Demonstratedtrack recordof effective people management, including direct experience leading, developing, and evaluating employees at the early-career stage
  • Substantive background in MEP design (mechanical, electrical, and/or plumbing disciplines) sufficient to evaluate work quality, communicate credibly with technical staff, and contextualize development feedback without performing technical work directly
  • Skilled at building and sustaining high-trust relationships in a fully remote environment; proven ability to foster team cohesion,maintainvisibility into team dynamics, and keep distributed employees engaged and connected
  • Strong coaching and feedback skills; able to deliver direct, developmentally oriented feedback across a range of performance levels and learning styles, including early-career employees who may be receiving structured feedback for the first time
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage individual development plans, team workflows, and administrative responsibilities across a cross-discipline team simultaneously
  • Proficient in Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and other collaboration tools used to coordinate and communicate effectively across a distributed workforce
  • Ability tooperateindependently on day-to-day responsibilities while escalating strategic decisions and complex people matters to HR and department leadership appropriately
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate clearly and withappropriate toneacross a team at varying levels of experience, as well as with peers and senior leadership
  • Ability toleverageAI and technology tools to support team coordination, development tracking, and communication workflows

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonableaccommodationmay be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position.
  • Frequently moving through office,facility, and other environments.
  • On occasion, may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • This position is fully remote; the employee may work from any location with a reliable internet connection and a professional, distraction-free home office setup
  • Occasional travel to DLB office locations, team gatherings, or department events may berequired; frequency is expected to be limited
  • Effective May 7, 2025, andin accordance withU.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) isrequiredfor any travel associated with this position. Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to meetings with employees, training events, and attending company or industry gatherings

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Building Systems, or a related technical field

OR

  • Associate's degree or equivalent withdemonstratedMEP industry experience at a level sufficient to credibly support and evaluate cross-discipline MEP design work

PLUS

  • Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive experience in MEP design or engineering, with at least 2–3 years in a formal people management role overseeing direct reports
  • Prior experience managing in a fully remote environment preferred;demonstratedability tomaintainteam cohesion and performance without relying on in-person presence
  • Experience leading cross-discipline or cross-functional teams a plus
  • Experience in engineering, construction, mission-critical facilities, or related technical industries preferred

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

Description

BioCatch is the leader in Behavioral Biometrics, a technology that leverages machine learning to analyze an online user’s physical and cognitive digital behavior to protect individuals online. BioCatch’s mission is to unlock the power of behavior and deliver actionable insights to create a digital world where identity, trust, and ease coexist. Today, 34 of the world's largest 100 banks and 210 total financial institutions rely on BioCatch Connect™ to combat fraud, facilitate digital transformation, and grow customer relationships. BioCatch’s Client Innovation Board, an industry-led initiative including American Express, Barclays, Citi Ventures, and National Australia Bank, helps BioCatch to identify creative and cutting-edge ways to leverage the unique attributes of behavior for fraud prevention. With over a decade of analyzing data, more than 80 registered patents, and unparalleled experience, BioCatch continues to innovate to solve tomorrow’s problems. For more information, please visit .

Position: Director, Global Advisory – South EMEA & Italy

Languages: French (Native/Fluent), English (Business Fluent) & Italian (Preferred)

Reports to: VP, Global Advisory

Summary

As Director, Global Advisory South EMEA & Italy, you will serve as a domain expert advisor and trusted partner to our regional sales and customer success teams. The role combines elements of subject matter expertise, consultative engagement, and thought leadership. You will help our largest customers solve complex fraud and financial crime challenges, translate customer needs into product innovation, and evangelise BioCatch’s value proposition at executive levels.

Role Responsibilities

  • Consultative advisory: Provide deep fraud/financial crime expertise and consulting support to sales teams, identifying opportunities at existing and new clients.
  • Customer engagement: Meet with customers’ senior fraud and risk leaders to understand business challenges and propose solutions based on BioCatch’s platform.
  • Thought leadership: Develop and deliver content (articles, webinars, conference presentations) to position BioCatch as a leader in behavioural intelligence and device-based fraud detection.
  • Evangelism: Represent BioCatch at company events, industry events and executive briefings; present complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Use case innovation: Identify emerging customer challenges and creative solution ideas and work with the Product team to prioritise new use cases and

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Backend Solutions Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
PositionType: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
ExperienceRequired: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems to design, build, and operate large-scale, high-throughput backend services that power mission-critical workloads. In this role you will architect the core platforms that other engineering teams build on, focusing on scalability, reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. The ideal candidate will combine strong fundamentals in computer science with practical, battle-tested experience operating distributed systems at scale, and will be comfortable navigating the trade-offs between consistency, availability, and latency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement large-scale distributed backend systems using Java, Go, Scala, or similar high-performance languages.
  • Architect data partitioning, replication, and consistency strategies appropriate to each workload’s requirements.
  • Build resilient APIs and event-driven services with strong observability, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns.
  • Optimize systems for latency, throughput, and cost, using profiling, benchmarking, and load testing.
  • Lead detailed architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and trade-off analyses.
  • Implement robust failure-handling patterns including retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, bulkheads, and saga workflows.
  • Design and operate data stores at scale, including relational, key-value, document, and search engines.
  • Build comprehensive observability into services with structured logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
  • Drive incident response and post-incident learning for critical backend services.
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and lead by example in code quality, design, and operational rigor.
  • Partner with SRE and platform teams to drive reliability improvements and reduce operational toil.
  • Contribute to long-term architecture and platform strategy, helping shape multi-year technical roadmaps and ensuring near-term execution remains aligned with the broader engineering direction.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Six or more years of professional backend engineering experience, with significant time on distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Java, Go, Scala, or similar.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including consensus, replication, and CAP trade-offs.
  • Hands-on experience with high-throughput message systems such as Kafka.
  • Experience operating systems at scale, including capacity planning and performance tuning.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores.
  • Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and mentorship skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience leading complex technical initiatives across multiple teams.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes-based platforms in production.
  • Exposure to service-mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd).
  • Familiarity with chaos engineering practices and tools.
  • Open-source contributions to relevant distributed systems projects.

raw.description:
Company Overview

team.blueis an ecosystem of 60+ successful brands working together across 22 European countries to provide its 3.3 million SMB customers with everything they need to succeed online by offering best-in-class expertise and services.

team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses that offer services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce, and server hosting solutions and, as specialist SaaS providers, adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools, and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.

Role:

We are looking for a hands-on, tech-savvy Head of Compliance to build and lead team.blue’s central Compliance function within group legal. Regulation is expanding quickly (AI Act, DSA, Data Act, DORA, NIS2, GDPR) and we operate across a fragmented, multi-country footprint. meets a fragmented, multi-geography footprint. This role is to turn that regulatory load into something teams can act upon themselves, rather than something we chase reactively.

Our operating philosophy is simple: enable, don’t gate — default to “how”, not “no”. Compliance is a growth lever, not a checkpoint. You will run a risk-based, pragmatic and scalable function: focus effort where likelihood × impact is highest, standardise and automate the routine, and reserve deep expertise for where it genuinely adds value. Good enough and fast beats perfect and late.

Given the size and geographical diversity of the group, the ambition is not a separate compliance silo. The function is embedded in group legal and works through co-creation: we set the standard once at the centre, enable divisions to self-serve through shared tools, and co-create with divisional General Counsels and legal-on-the-ground, who own their product and commercial risk posture within that standard.

Team & Leadership Scope:

This is a people-leadership role. You will lead and develop a central compliance capability, with the following reporting into you:

  • Privacy Counsels — the group’s data-protection and GDPR specialists.
  • AI Counsels — the group’s AI Act and AI-governance specialists.
  • A general compliance risk-monitoring and assurance function — regulatory watch, continuous risk monitoring, the assurance loop and adoption tracking (AI-enabled).

You steer this team to standardise once and scale everywhere, and you steer, rather than manage, local legal counsels to embed compliance in the business lines.

You will also have access to the operational Legal Hub, headed by the legal ops lead, and act as a spoke to it: you deploy your standards, policies and playbooks as self-serve templates and automation through the Hub, and draw on its shared tooling, regulatory-watch and risk analytics.

You set and steer the standard; the Hub is the delivery layer that scales it.

Key Responsibilities:

Compliance Advisory & Implementation

  • Act as a first-line (1LOD) advisory function embedded in group legal, working alongside legal and the business rather than at arm’s length — enabling delivery, not blocking it.
  • Drive the practical implementation of regulatory requirements into the business lines — translating obligations into operational change and self-serve readiness, not just written guidance.
  • Apply a risk-based approach to set priorities across the group’s brands and jurisdictions, as a joint call with the business, not a legal veto.

Regulatory Scope — Data & Technology

  • Own the group compliance agenda on data- and technology-driven legislation, which forms the core of the remit: GDPR, the AI Act, the Data Act, DORA and NIS2.
  • Coordinate the group’s Digital Services Act (DSA) standard centrally — setting a single approach to avoid fragmented entity-level reporting — while the operational abuse-report handling is executed by the divisions (see Scope Boundaries).
  • Set the group standard, policies and playbooks on these topics, and deploy them as self-serve templates and automation through the Legal Hub.
  • Anticipate incoming EU digital regulation and assess its operational impact across the portfolio.

Broader Compliance Topics

  • Own or coordinate the wider compliance agenda, including sanctions, AML, conflicts of interest, third-party risk management (TPRM), fraud, consumer protection and business integrity.
  • Safeguard independence of judgement on topics that require it — notably whistleblowing, conflicts of interest and TPRM — and provide independent oversight on escalation.

Risk Monitoring & Assurance

  • Own the group’s compliance risk-monitoring and assurance loop — continuous monitoring, not point-in-time assurances — so our controls are demonstrable and our register stays current.
  • Run regulatory watch and translate change into prioritised, register-driven action.
  • Steer the function by clear KPIs (maturity and awareness, self-serve adoption, response time, residual risk).

Co-Creation with Divisional General Counsels

  • Partner with divisional GCs as co-owners of compliance, not recipients of policy — they steer their own product and commercial risk posture within the group standard you set.
  • Foster a genuine compliance culture across the divisions, enabling local counsels and non-legal teams to self-serve and apply standards, escalating only true exceptions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and divisional GCs on compliance risk and regulatory exposure.
  • Work closely with the Sustainability Director to advance team.blue’s digital-trust agenda — connecting data protection, AI governance and platform integrity to the group’s ESG and responsible-technology commitments, so trust is treated as both a compliance and a sustainability outcome.
Skills & Qualifications:

Education & Professional Background

• Qualified lawyer.

  • Proven seniority at manager level, with the standing to promote compliance culture while operationally driving implementation forward — not only thinking, but doing.
  • Demonstrated experience in an internal compliance role, preferably in the non-financial (1LOD advisory) sector rather than a regulated financial-services 2LOD control function.
  • Not a transactional lawyer — this is an operational, implementation-led compliance leadership role.
  • Experience in an international or multi-jurisdictional environment is a strong advantage.

Technical Skills

  • Knowledge of IT- and data-driven legislation (GDPR, AI Act, Data Act, DSA, DORA, NIS2).
  • Genuinely tech-savvy from an operational point of view — comfortable in a fast-moving digital environment (a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have).
  • Fluent with a risk-based, self-serve and automation-first way of working — build it once so it is reused, not redone.
  • Ability to prioritise and lead a broad, multi-topic compliance agenda across a decentralised group.

Language Requirements

  • Fluent in English (group working language).
  • Additional European language skills are an advantage.

Core Competencies

  • Enabler, not gatekeeper — you default to “how”, not “no”, and treat legal confidence as a growth lever.
  • Hands-on and operational — you both think and do; you move topics from policy to implementation.
  • Pragmatic and risk-based — you focus effort where the exposure is greatest and accept that good enough and fast beats perfect and late.
  • A co-creator — you build with divisional GCs and the business, not around them.
  • Good communicator, credible and convincing across legal, business and leadership audiences.
  • High personal integrity — integer, and trusted to hold an independent line where required.
  • Able to lead through influence, steering counsels you do not directly manage.
What We Offer
  • A senior, high-impact role building and leading the group compliance function from within, with direct access to the Group General Counsel and group leadership.
  • Ownership of the EU digital-regulation agenda
  • A team to lead — privacy, AI and compliance risk-monitoring specialists — and the mandate to shape the function.
  • A collaborative, international environment where legal and compliance are seen as strategic partners.
  • Competitive compensation package, including participation in group incentive plans.

• Remote or Hybrid working arrangements.

"Come as you are"

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

ESG

"Atteam.blue, our commitment to caring for the environment and each other is at the heart of everything we do. Our latest impact report showcases our ongoing ESG efforts and ambitious sustainability goals. Interested in learning more about our dedication to making a positive impact? Check it outhere.”

raw.description:
About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
  • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast.

We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge is launching a Forward Deployed Engineering motion to go deeper with our health system partners. As one of the founding Forward Deployed Product Managers, you will run focused engagements with our health system partners: going on-site to understand the workflow gap, scoping the engagement with the partner, and owning the outcome end-to-end. You will lead a pod and feed your learnings from the field directly back into the core Abridge product.

This is a role for a senior product leader who can earn the trust of CMOs, CMIOs, CIOs, and operational leaders inside large health systems, while staying close enough to our core product roadmap to make sharp technical trade-offs in real time. You will set the tone for what forward deployed means at Abridge: deep, fast, opinionated, and focused on solving our partners’ most burning problems, which in turn strengthens our core product suite overall.

This role is based out of our San Francisco office and is in-person Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Please only apply if you are open to relocation and our hybrid in-person model in San Francisco.

What You’ll Do

  • Run discovery on-site at our partner accounts. Meet with the executive sponsor, clinicians, and integration teams to scope the engagement and define success before any code is written.

  • Lead a small pod through focused, sprint-style engagements, protecting pod focus and pace.

  • Own the product and feature answer for the engagement, partnering with Partner Success on the broader commercial relationship.

  • Decide what gets built, what gets declined, and what gets routed to the core roadmap. Hold the line on bespoke requests that don't generalize back to the core product.

  • Partner with internal product and engineering teams when an engagement surfaces a net-new product build that belongs on a different track.

What you'll bring

  • 7+ years of product management experience shipping products that users love, with a track record of owning product areas end-to-end.

  • Builder mentality. You've personally driven products from discovery through launch and iteration. You care about craft and quality in what you ship.

  • Strong user empathy and product taste. You instinctively know the difference between a product that works and one that delights.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can take a messy problem space and create a clear roadmap without waiting for perfect information.

  • Cross-functional credibility. You can go deep with engineers on technical tradeoffs, partner with design on interaction details, and operate as the senior product
    voice in front of CMOs, CMIOs, CIOs, and CFOs.

  • Track record of running time-bound, outcome-oriented engagements where the deliverable was a live system, not a document.

  • Willingness to travel ~20% on average, with surge periods around engagement kickoff and go-live.

Bonus points if:

  • Healthcare or clinical workflow experience, or familiarity with Epic or other EHR platforms.

  • Prior experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing product role at an enterprise AI company.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $260K - $290K

Overview

Consilio is a global leader in legal consulting and services, helping corporate legal departments and law firms transform operations through technology, process optimisation, and data-driven strategies. Our Ironclad Practice delivers end-to-end Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) implementations, combining legal expertise with structured, scalable delivery methodologies.

Consilio is seeking an experienced Ironclad Project Manager to lead end-to-end client implementations within our Ironclad Practice.

You will operate within a structured delivery team, working closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and Legal Engineers to ensure successful execution of Ironclad CLM deployments. This role is responsible for owning project delivery, ensuring alignment to scope, timelines, and quality standards, while driving collaboration across technical and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Governance

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of Ironclad CLM implementations across multiple client engagements
  • Define and manage project scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Monitor project performance, proactively managing risks, issues, and dependencies
  • Ensure delivery aligns with agreed Statement of Work (SOW), budget, and quality expectations

Delivery Team Coordination

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including Solution Architects, Legal Engineers, and Delivery Managers
  • Ensure clear roles, responsibilities, and accountability across the delivery lifecycle
  • Facilitate sprint planning, stand-ups, and status reporting within agile or hybrid delivery models
  • Support resource planning and utilisation in collaboration with Delivery leadership

Client Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle
  • Build strong relationships with Legal, Procurement, Sales, and IT teams
  • Provide regular status updates, executive reporting, and steering committee communications
  • Manage client expectations and drive alignment on priorities and outcomes

Implementation Oversight

  • Oversee the delivery of Ironclad configurations, workflows, integrations, and data migration activities
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects to ensure designs are implemented effectively
  • Ensure successful completion of key phases including discovery, build, testing, UAT, and go-live

Risk & Change Management

  • Identify, track, and mitigate project risks and issues
  • Manage scope changes, ensuring proper governance and documentation
  • Support change management and user adoption strategies for successful rollout

Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure adherence to Consilio delivery standards, methodologies, and best practices
  • Drive high-quality outputs across all phases of implementation
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of delivery frameworks, tools, and templates within the Ironclad Practice

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience managing CLM or SaaS implementation projects (Ironclad strongly preferred)
  • Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management (CLM) and legal operations processes
  • Experience working in cross-functional delivery teams (Project Managers, Architects, Engineers)
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a client-facing environment
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering Ironclad CLM implementations
  • Background in legal technology, consulting, or professional services
  • Familiarity with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, DocuSign, Microsoft ecosystem, or integration platforms
  • Experience with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, Asana, MS Project)
  • PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or equivalent certification

Soft Skills

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement
  • Strong organisational and planning capabilities
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity across complex projects
  • Proactive, solutions-focused mindset with strong problem-solving skills
  • Collaborative approach with the ability to lead cross-functional teams

What You’ll Be Part Of

  • A high-performing Ironclad Practice delivering global CLM implementations
  • A structured delivery model alongside Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and Legal Engineers
  • A collaborative, fast-paced environment focused on innovation and client impact

Why Join Consilio?

At Consilio, you will play a central role in delivering transformative legal technology solutions. As part of our Ironclad Practice, you’ll lead complex implementations, work with global clients, and shape the future of legal operations through best-in-class CLM delivery.

Consilio’s True North Values

  • Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  • Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  • Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
  • Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

Job Title: Senior Consultant, Commercial Solutions & Insights Hub (CSIH), Analytic Services

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

To be eligible for this position, you must currently reside in the same country where the job is located. This role will require travel to client sites within the US as needed. Candidates that can work a hybrid schedule going into an IQVIA office several times per week in PA, NY, NJ or CT are preferred.


IQVIA CSIH is a market-leading, service delivery-oriented division within IQVIA Commercial Solutions. CSIH team members consult with manufacturers in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries to meet the challenges of today’s complex and evolving healthcare landscape. Analytic Services leverages the power of healthcare data to help its clients formulate methodologies that answer business questions in a broad spectrum of areas of expertise-providing deep insights into patient, payer, and prescriber behaviors.


As a valued member of the Analytic Services team, you will actively:

  • Design analytics and execute them. You will acquire knowledge of IQVIA data sources, lead analysis to inform strategic recommendations, develop data analyses systems, and identify trends in complex data sets.
  • Provide business consulting and project management: You will apply consulting methodologies to deliver engagements, create presentations for clients, manage projects, cultivate professional relationships with client teams, and work with management to prioritize needs.
  • Synthesize complex data into actionable results and recommendations from the evaluation of secondary data sources to answer a wide range of market, therapeutic, prescriber, patient, payer, and competitive related questions.
  • Assist in developing detailed documentation and specifications, including business process documentation, SOPs, and client data scorecards.

CSIH seeks team members who demonstrate strength in our core competencies including:

  • Ownership
  • Growth
  • Innovation
  • Collaboration

As a member of the team, you will have the opportunity to not only learn from but also contribute to the vibrant CSIH community. You will participate in learning communities to codify your data analytics subject-matter expertise and develop training content available to the entire team.


Job Summary

  • Manager level candidates are expected to work independently with minimal senior support.
  • Analyze secondary data and market research to identify key insights and trends.
  • Lead quantitative and qualitative analyses to support client deliverables and business decisions using IQVIA data.
  • Independently create client presentations and actively participate in, support, and present at client meetings.
  • Manage projects and work streams of reasonable complexity.
  • Be able to quickly learn and work with sales and promotional data, market and epidemiology assessment, pipeline analysis and market research.
  • Develop project plans with clear timelines and deliverables, ensuring on time and on budget execution.
  • Coach consultants across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Collaborate effectively across internal and external teams to achieve project and organizational goals.

Skills & Experience

  • Hands on experience with Patient Analytics, including IQVIA or similar data at patient, prescriber, and account levels (e.g. Anonymous patient-level data (APLD), LAAD etc.,).
  • Experience with sales and marketing analytics using sub national data (patient, physician, or payer level).
  • Experience supporting analytics such as Source of Business, Compliance, Payer, Patient Journey, Promo Mix Modeling, Segmentation, and Targeting.
  • Strong technical skills in Excel, SAS, SQL, R, Tableau, and/or Excel VBA.
  • Strong project management skills with consistent delivery of high-quality outcomes.
  • Strong analytical, interpretative, and problem-solving skills, including working with large and complex data sets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree or higher with 6–8 years of relevant healthcare experience.
  • Strong interest in healthcare analytics with knowledge of the US healthcare market.
  • Ability to follow SOPs, document project work, and adhere to processes Strong business acumen and understanding of sales and marketing principles
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills
  • Strong written, numerical, and problem-solving abilities
  • Adaptable, with the ability to learn and apply new concepts quickly

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

raw.description:
Do you love turning keyword insights into content that people genuinely want to read and act on? Are you driven by helping customers discover the right products through search at exactly the right moment? Can you translate complex products and seasonal needs into clear, trustworthy content that drives both engagement and conversion? Do you enjoy blending data, creativity, and hands-on execution as search evolves across Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and other generative search experiences? Are you excited by developing SEO strategies that help customers discover products through traditional search, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)? If you're excited by owning impactful, SEO-driven content and search strategies in an eCommerce environment, this role is for you.

The Pond Guy / Airmax, Inc. is the leading manufacturer and distributor of pond, lake, and water garden products- including aeration systems, fountains, and water treatments—to a nationwide network of end-users and Airmax dealers.

Watch now to learn about The Pond Guy:

Job Description

We’re seeking a strategic and creative SEO Content Strategist who can bridge the gap between keyword intelligence and compelling, high-performing content. In this role, you’ll develop and execute SEO-driven content strategies that increase organic visibility, strengthen category authority, and help drive qualified traffic and conversion across The Pond Guy’s eCommerce ecosystem. You’ll play a key role in growing organic traffic, improving category visibility, increasing customer engagement, and supporting revenue growth through content-led SEO strategies.

This is a remote role supporting The Pond Guy’s eCommerce business, with a strong focus on product education, category-level SEO, and content that supports customer decision-making and conversion. You will help customers understand what to buy, when to buy it, and how to use it through clear, trustworthy, and search-optimized content.

You’ll also plan and optimize content around strong seasonality and weather-driven demand, aligning organic search strategy with pond, lake, and water garden maintenance cycles throughout the year. This is a hands-on role supporting The Pond Guy’s growing eCommerce business through content-led organic growth, product education, category-level SEO, and customer conversion.

Responsibilities

Here are some examples of work your day would include:

  • Own and evolve SEO-driven content strategies that grow organic traffic, strengthen category visibility, and improve content performance across a variety of content such as blogs, product pages, category pages, and FAQs
  • Produce high-quality, search-optimized content from concept through final draft
  • Conduct in-depth keyword research with a focus on search intent, content gaps, and competitive opportunities
  • Lead SEO reporting and use performance insights to prioritize optimization opportunities, improve rankings, and increase organic engagement and conversion
  • Execute on-page SEO by crafting compelling and optimized meta titles, meta descriptions, header structures, schema-aware content layouts, and internal linking recommendations
  • Ensure content aligns with SEO best practices while maintaining strong readability, brand voice, and conversion intent
  • Stay current on evolving search, AI, and content trends to proactively inform strategy. Apply a strong understanding of generative engine optimization and large language model behavior
  • Partner with Marketing, eCommerce, and Creative teams to translate technical SEO insights into clear, actionable content recommendations

Success in this role will be measured by growth in organic traffic, keyword visibility, customer engagement, and conversion-driving content performance.

Don’t know about ponds? That’s okay! You’ll be trained to be proficient in your job. We utilize an interactive combination of hands-on and visual training to ensure everyone has a full understanding of TPG, Inc.’s proactive approach to pond management.

Skill Set

To be successful in this role, you need to have a certain amount of knowledge and skills:

  • Minimum of 3–5 years of professional experience in SEO content strategy or content-focused SEO, preferably within a B2C eCommerce selling physical goods
  • Solid understanding of on-page SEO fundamentals, search intent, and conversion-focused content, particularly within an eCommerce environment
  • Strong keyword research experience using enterprise SEO tools to identify search opportunities, analyze keyword performance, and map keywords to product categories, individual products, and educational content.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to personally produce clear, authoritative, and customer-focused content
  • Hands-on experience using GA4 and Google Search Console to analyze content performance and guide optimization decisions
  • High level of attention to detail, with strong proofreading skills and the ability to balance feedback while advocating for content best practices

We need a self-motivated SEO Content Strategist who is innovative and flexible. This person should have a strong attention to detail in proofreading and brand compliance while continually adding value to the organization beyond their day-to-day tasks. The ideal candidate is resourceful, creative, and ready to get things done.

This position requires manual dexterity for typing, sitting at a desk and looking at a computer screen for long periods of time. In addition, portions of the position may require job shadowing and training which includes physical activity of lifting 25-35 pounds and standing for long periods of time.

Availability

This is a full-time position. The typical schedule will be 7:30am – 4:30pm ET Monday – Friday. However, some evenings and Saturdays may be required for projects that must be done outside of normal business hours.

Remote Position
Our SEO Content Strategist role is a work from home position. However, there are certain times you may be required to come onsite, or report virtually, for training or other employer sponsored events that are during or outside your normal work schedule. Remote employees must be able to meet the standards of The Pond Guy’s telecommuting policy which include internet speeds and workspace requirements.

Compensation

This is a full-time salaried position with benefits. Benefits include:

  • Blue Cross Blue Shield Healthcare
  • Blue Cross Blue Shield Dental Insurance
  • Blue Cross Blue Shield Vision Insurance
  • Short-term Disability Insurance
  • Long-term Disability Insurance
  • Accident Insurance
  • Critical Illness Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Holiday pay effective immediately (8 holidays recognized)
  • 401k with employer 4% match and revenue sharing
  • Employee referral program
  • Additional Training Programs: Career Development and Department Shadows

Company Overview

TPG, Inc. is a growing company with over 160 employees. We are a manufacturing company for pond, lake and water garden supplies with customers in all 50 states servicing both wholesale and end-users. We have customers with large ponds used for swimming, fishing and ice skating and customers with decorative water gardens containing Koi, waterfalls, and plants. Our mission is to help the world enjoy ponds by being passionate, knowledgeable and providing innovative solutions.

TPG, Inc. is not just a team, we’re a tribe. A tribe is more like a family and is ongoing. We have fun, pursue our goals, and help each other grow. Becoming part of TPG, Inc. means more than getting a job it’s a career move. We will give you the support you need to grow with us.

Company Divisions

TPG, Inc. encompasses a family of businesses to support customers in all pond aspects.

Airmax, Inc. – business-to-business and manufacturing. airmaxeco.com

The Pond Guy, Inc. – direct-to-consumer. thepondguy.com

The Pond Guy, Inc. – local services division. weknowponds.com

How To Apply For Position

Step 1: Submit Resume.

Step 2: If selected for further review, you will receive a request to take a ten-minute survey. Please complete the survey within three days of receipt.

Step 3: If selected for further review, you will be contacted for an interview.

The Pond Guy, Inc. prides itself on the quality of its employees and as such, candidates who receive a job offer will be required to successfully pass a drug/toxins test and background check.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Senior Lead Product Manager, Market Strategy & Investment Planning will identify, size, and prioritize market expansion opportunities across the Infrastructure Products portfolio. This role will connect market demand with network feasibility and investment economics to guide where Lumen should expand, modernize, or deploy capital.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain product and geographic market sizing, including Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM), and Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM).
  • Analyze market demand, customer concentration, competitive dynamics, growth trends, network reach, and infrastructure readiness.
  • Create a consistent market-attractiveness framework to stack rank metros, routes, and other expansion opportunities.
  • Partner with Network Planning to assess capacity, build feasibility, deployment timing, and network alternatives.
  • Build investment cases that quantify revenue potential, margin, capital requirements, time to revenue, payback, and strategic value.
  • Recommend portfolio and capital priorities to Product, Network Planning, Finance, and senior leadership.
  • Maintain decision-ready dashboards and executive materials, and track approved investments against expected market and financial outcomes.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, market strategy, network planning, corporate strategy, finance, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience with market sizing, segmentation, financial modeling, business cases, or investment prioritization.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert complex market and network data into clear recommendations.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional work and influence decisions across Product, Network Planning, Finance, Sales, and Strategy.
  • Clear executive communication and presentation skills.

Preferred Experience

Experience in telecommunications, fiber, wavelength, Ethernet, dark fiber, colocation, data centers, cloud connectivity, or other infrastructure-intensive markets.

Measures of Success

  • Consistent and credible TAM, SAM, and SOM models for priority products and markets.
  • Clear, fact-based market rankings that inform expansion and capital decisions.
  • Improved alignment between market demand, product strategy, network plans, and investment returns.
  • Transparent tracking of forecasted versus realized commercial and financial outcomes.

POSITION SUMMARY

FUNDINGO is seeking an Implementation Manager to join our growing Delivery team. The Implementation Manager owns client implementations day to day, from post-sale kickoff through training and go-live. You are the primary point of contact for clients during onboarding, responsible for managing the timeline, scope, risks, and communication while configuring the FUNDINGO platform to meet each client's business needs.

You will manage multiple concurrent implementations, run client working sessions independently, and answer most client questions on your own. You will partner with our Solutions Consultant, who owns solution design for complex or unique requirements, advises on edge cases and best practices, and validates the approach when a project reaches the limits of standard functionality.

ABOUT FUNDINGO

FUNDINGO is a Salesforce-native loan management platform helping lenders manage the complete lending lifecycle, including origination, servicing, accounting, borrower management, and workflow automation.

Our customers include non-bank lenders, private lenders, CDFIs, financial institutions, and organizations with complex lending operations. FUNDINGO serves as a mission-critical operating platform that powers how these organizations run their businesses.

Our implementations can be complex and highly configurable, requiring coordination across customers, project managers, implementation resources, product experts, engineering, QA, and third-party vendors.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Implementation Ownership

  • Own assigned implementations day to day, leading clients through the full lifecycle from kickoff through training and go-live.

  • Manage project timelines, scope, milestones, and deliverables across multiple concurrent client projects.

  • Identify project risks early, discuss mitigation strategies with the client, and escalate issues when necessary.

  • Prepare daily and/or weekly status reports and communicate regularly with clients, obtaining feedback and approval throughout configuration.

  • Manage the Jira board for assigned projects, ensuring tickets are properly prioritized, assigned, and tracked to meet deadlines.

Client Engagement & Requirements

  • Run requirements and configuration working sessions with clients independently.

  • Ask questions to fully understand client processes from start to finish, applying logical thinking to identify gaps and clarify the underlying need before proposing an approach.

  • Serve as the first line of answers for client questions about FUNDINGO functionality and configuration.

Configuration & Delivery

  • Learn the FUNDINGO platform deeply and configure and test standard product functionality, including pages, fields, flows, and layouts, to meet client business needs.

  • Connect business requirements to specific configuration decisions, considering downstream impacts before making changes.

  • Troubleshoot configuration issues independently before escalating, and document issues clearly for the development team when escalation is needed.

  • Write detailed tickets based on gathered requirements, clearly outlining requirements, acceptance criteria, and relevant details.

  • Guide and assist clients through the data conversion and data migration process.

  • Develop training and configuration documentation to support internal and external stakeholders.

Collaboration with Solutions Consultant

  • Recognize when a requirement is complex, unique, or outside standard product functionality, and bring in the Solutions Consultant for solution design.

  • Execute solution designs provided by the Solutions Consultant and keep them informed of implementation progress and issues.

  • Apply recommended implementation patterns and configuration standards consistently across projects.

Continuous Improvement

  • Share feedback from client implementations to help improve FUNDINGO products, processes, and templates.

  • Record time spent on projects daily to ensure accurate tracking and reporting.

  • Attain quarterly and annual objectives defined collaboratively with management.

  • Additional tasks as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in product implementation, business analysis, consulting, technical support, or technical problem-solving.

  • Salesforce administration, including building objects, fields, page layouts, and flows

  • Demonstrated ownership of implementation work across multiple phases, from requirements through go-live.

  • Strong communication and customer relations skills, with a consultative approach to understanding client needs.

  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and adapt quickly to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

NICE TO HAVES

  • 2+ years of lending experience (loan origination, servicing, CDFI, or alternative lending)

  • Experience in client services in a B2B/SaaS environment

  • Project Lead or Project Management experience

  • Data Migration experience

  • Jira experience

WHAT WE OFFER

The opportunity

  • Be part of the legacy of a growing company at an inflection point, with the chance to make a real impact on our mission

  • Build and operate the delivery engine behind increasingly complex and enterprise-level customer engagements.

  • Take meaningful ownership rather than inheriting a narrowly defined corporate function.

  • Work directly with company leadership and have visibility into the broader business.

  • Build a function that can grow in scope and responsibility as FUNDINGO grows.

  • Help shape the operating model of a Salesforce-native lending technology company.

  • Work in a fully remote environment with a distributed team.

The package

  • Competitive compensation package based on experience and market

  • Full-time role with significant growth potential as FUNDINGO scales

  • 100% of employee medical and dental premiums covered

  • 401(k) with maximum match, vested as you go

  • 15 paid holidays per year

Compensation Range: $100K - $140K

New Hampshire is known for its strong economy, with a mix of healthcare, financial services, technology, manufacturing, education, and retail businesses. Well-connected by major highways and regional airports, New Hampshire provides convenient access throughout the state and to the greater Boston metropolitan area. The territory includes a mix of regional markets such as Burlington, Montpelier, Rutland, Bennington, and other surrounding communities. Vermont has a diverse economy supported by healthcare, education, tourism, manufacturing, agriculture, and small business. The state offers a variety of outdoor recreational opportunities, cultural attractions, and local business centers that serve as important hubs for their surrounding areas.   • Demonstrated entrepreneurial mindset with proven track record of successfully launching, managing, or growing a business or startup utilizing innovation, strategic planning, and critical thinking skills.

    • Presentation skills - effectively conveys information in a clear and professional manner to internal and/or external individuals/groups.

Our Benefits

(SFIMC), and that you become registered and remain in good standing as required by SFVPMC, SFIMC and FINRA. This position requires you to obtain/maintain state insurance licenses and certifications, and all other applicable licensing and certifications for the role including, but not limited to, LTC Certification, Annuities Certification and potential state securities licensing as applicable.

If you do not currently hold all applicable licensing, certifications, and registration, they must be obtained within approximately 3 months of your start date. During this time period, you will be placed in a temporary Licensing Candidate – UNS job in a non-exempt status while obtaining your required licensing, securities registration, and certifications. Once all required licensing, securities registration, and certifications are complete and verified, you will be placed into the Sales Leader job at the start of the next pay period.

About the role:

Indivisible Project is hiring for a Senior Group Fundraising Associate to join our Movement Support team. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Distributed Fundraising, the Senior Group Fundraising Associate will provide day-to-day assistance and guidance to group leaders participating in the distributed fundraising program, supporting Indivisible groups with a user-friendly experience to legally and effectively fundraise and spend funds through our national entity.

This position serves as an important point of contact for program participants. This role is responsible for managing key administrative functions for tracking fundraising and spending within the program, ensuring that groups have clear, accurate information, that compliance requirements are easy to navigate, and that leaders feel supported as they grow their organizing capacity.

This role also collaborates regularly with colleagues across departments. The ideal candidate will balance a service-oriented approach with the ability to communicate expectations clearly, consistently enforce program requirements, and navigate sensitive compliance issues professionally.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a structured, process-driven environment and takes genuine satisfaction in keeping systems organized, records accurate, and important details from falling through the cracks.

We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate a strong sense of ownership over their responsibilities. Successful candidates will be comfortable managing an established workload independently, identifying what needs attention, proactively following up on outstanding items, and moving work forward without requiring frequent direction or reminders. Thriving in a fast-paced environment, they will manage sensitive communications, compliance requirements and competing priorities with precision and care as well as examining our current and future processes through a lens that incorporates diversity, equity and inclusion. Success in this role will depend on building strong relationships internally with staff as well as externally with a diverse base of Indivisible groups, while upholding confidentiality and demonstrating a deep commitment to Indivisible's mission and a flexible, solutions-oriented mindset.

This is a full-time role expected to require 40 hours of work per week; the salary for this position is $83,900 a year. Indivisible offers a comprehensive employer-sponsored benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; a company-sponsored Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA); FSA with limited matching, and a 401(k) retirement plan with up to a 5% employer match. Employees are fully vested upon becoming eligible.

What you'll do:

Program Management and Compliance - 90%
  • Communicate effectively to Indivisible group leaders about the program, including:
    • (1) serving as an email helpdesk to respond quickly and professionally to group treasurers in the program and groups interested in learning more about it, and
    • (2) proactively sharing guidance around engagement with national programs and campaigns, including other related financial support programs.
  • Partner with legal, finance, and program staff to ensure groups understand and comply with the appropriate use of funds.
  • Assist with onboarding groups to the distributed fundraising program, ensuring leaders understand eligibility, compliance requirements, and how to make the most of available resources.
  • Help develop innovative, efficiency-driven review, approval, and spending-tracking processes for program participants.
  • Facilitate funding transfers and support the administrative processes that enable groups to receive and use financial support efficiently.
  • Develop trainings, resources, and toolkits on how to effectively use the distributed fundraising program to fundraise and spend.
  • Provide assistance with reviewing other financial support requests by groups while ensuring distributed fundraising compliance checks at all times.
  • Other tasks as needed to support future evolutions of the program.
Team Support - 10%
  • Assist as needed with team wide efforts for movement support

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of relevant professional experience with at least 2 years experience in nonprofit fundraising, program administration, operations or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and consistently meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent customer service skills, with an emphasis on providing personalized and individual support.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with experience managing systems and processes, as well as the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate policies, requirements, and sensitive information clearly and professionally.
  • Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, including the ability to organize, maintain, review, and manipulate data accurately.
  • Comfort with recurring, detail-intensive administrative work, including data entry, record reconciliation, document review, and compliance tracking.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, track outstanding tasks and demonstrate accountability in managing time-sensitive responsibilities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across departments while maintaining independent ownership of assigned work.
  • Commitment to Indivisible Project’s values including diversity and inclusion.

Desired Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of relevant professional experience with at least 2 years experience in nonprofit fundraising, program administration, operations or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and consistently meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent customer service skills, with an emphasis on providing personalized and individual support.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with experience managing systems and processes, as well as the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate policies, requirements, and sensitive information clearly and professionally.

About Indivisible Project

We’re building something new. We’re a progressive grassroots organization that began in the aftermath of Trump’s election. We’re working to build a democracy that reflects a broad, multiracial “we the people,” one that works for all of us and is sustained by all of us. To support this movement, we’ve built an incredible team at the national level. We dream big, we support each other, and we have fun doing it. For more information about Indivisible’s vision, mission, and theory of change, click here.

We’re changing what’s politically possible. Indivisible is part of the powerful progressive movement reaction to Trump, fighting the racist, misogynistic, plutocratic, and authoritarian agenda trumpeted by Trump and the GOP congress. Don’t take our word for it; Indivisible has been featured on the Rachel Maddow Show multiple times, as well as in the New York Times and in pretty much every other major news outlet in the country.

We’re building together. We’re building a new organization every day - a rare opportunity to model what we want to see in the world. We’re deeply committed to equity and building a diverse and inclusive organization.

We’re looking for you. If you want to fight for the soul of American democracy, there’s no better place to be than Indivisible. We’re looking for more team members who are passionate about building an inclusive democracy and committed to getting results. It’s an exciting, fulfilling place if you’re someone who wants to fight fiercely for the progressive world we want to have.

Every one of us on the national team is here because we believe this movement is the best way to retake and build progressive power in this country. Does that ring true for you? If so, great - throw your hat in the ring to join our team. Let’s start #winning together. For more information about Indivisible’s organizational principles, click here.

Indivisible Project is an equal opportunity employer. We strongly encourage and seek applications from women, people of color, including bilingual and bicultural individuals, as well as members of the lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender communities. Applicants shall not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, sex, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, ancestry, national origin, marital or family status, caregiving responsibilities, genetic information, class or caste, personal appearance (including size and weight), immigrant status, military status, veteran status or other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodation will be made so that qualified disabled applicants may participate in the application process. Please advise in writing of support needs at the time of application.
