raw.description:
About Centerbase
At Centerbase, we empower mid-size law firms to run their practices more efficiently, profitably, and client-centrically. Our cloud-based legal practice management platform streamlines the entire client lifecycle from intake to billing to business intelligence, helping attorneys deliver exceptional service while achieving their growth goals.
We’re more than just a software provider—we’re a partner in transformation. With a focus on automation, flexibility, and continuous innovation, we give firms the tools to modernize operations, improve collaboration, and adapt to the evolving expectations of today’s clients and legal professionals. At Centerbase, we come to work every day committed to making legal work easier, smarter, and more impactful for the firms and communities we serve.
Everything we do is guided by four core values:
  • Customer Centric
  • Stronger Together
  • Be the Difference
  • Relentless Improvement
These values shape who we are: a dedicated, inventive, and passionate team committed to empowering law firms to achieve lasting growth and success.

The role

You own two growth engines at Centerbase: events and content. Every event you run should create pipeline or deepen a customer relationship. Every piece of content should help Sales win a deal or help Customer Success keep a client.
This is a hands-on role. You set the strategy and you do the work. You run our tradeshows and regional field events alongside Sales. You host our customers. Then you turn those moments into content that keeps working long after the booth comes down.
You report to the CMO. You work side by side with Sales and Customer Success leaders every week. You bring an AI-forward mindset and use it to plan and measure faster than a traditional team could.

Key Responsibilities

What you'll own: Events

• Plan and budget. Build the annual events plan and budget. Tie every dollar to a pipeline or retention target.
• Tradeshows. Run the program end to end. Choose the national legal tech shows and regional legal events that put us in front of midsize firms.
• Booth performance. Own booth strategy, staffing, demos, lead capture and follow-up. Get every lead into Salesforce and a follow-up sequence within 48 hours.
• Regional field marketing. Build a field program with Sales in priority markets. Host executive dinners, roundtables, partner events and local meetups. Fill each room with the accounts Sales most wants to win.
• Customer events. Own the Front & Center Tour client roadshow. Build user groups and appreciation events with Customer Success that drive adoption and expansion.
• Partner events. Co-host events with our technology and implementation partners to reach new firms.
• Sales Kickoff. Organize and manage internal events, including annual SKO.
• Vendors and sponsorships. Manage association memberships and sponsorships. Negotiate with venues, booth builders, travel providers and production vendors.
• Results. Report on every event: cost per lead, cost per opportunity, sourced and influenced pipeline, customer attendance. Recommend where to invest next.

What you'll own: content

• Content strategy. Own the plan across the funnel. Map content to buying stage and to our two audiences: managing partners and firm operations leaders.
• Editorial calendar. Tie the calendar to product launches and the events plan. Publish on a steady cadence.
• Hands-on creation. Write and edit the work yourself. You'll draft blog posts, guides, case studies, email copy, webinar content and event presentations.
• Event-to-content engine. Turn every event into session recaps, customer stories, video clips and social posts. One event should fuel weeks of content.
• Tradeshow enablement. Work with the booth and customer event teams to ensure they have the right talk tracks, plans and understand objectives.
• AI in the workflow. Use AI for research, first drafts, repurposing and performance analysis. Hold every piece to a human editor's standard for accuracy and voice.
• Distribution. Partner with Demand Generation on SEO and promotion so content reaches the right buyers.
• Results. Measure content by pipeline influence and engagement, not output volume.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• B2B tech experience. 5+ years in B2B technology marketing, with real ownership of events and content.
• Tradeshow ownership. You've run a full tradeshow calendar end to end, from show selection to lead follow-up and ROI reporting.
• Regional field marketing. You've built field events in multiple markets with sales teams. You can show the pipeline they produced.
• Customer events. You've run user conferences, client roadshows, user groups or advisory boards that customers valued.
• Writing and editing. You write well and fast. You bring a portfolio of B2B content you created or led.
• AI-forward mindset. You use AI tools in your work today. You can show where they saved time and money.
• Hands-on leadership. You've worked on lean teams where leaders do the work, not just direct it.
• Budget discipline. You manage spend with care and tie every investment to pipeline.
• Systems fluency. You're comfortable in Salesforce and marketing automation. You connect event data to pipeline reporting.
• Travel. You're ready to travel for shows and regional events, including some evenings and weekends.

Nice to have

• Legal industry or legal tech experience.
• Relationships with legal associations or legal tech show organizers.
• Experience at a growth equity or PE-backed SaaS company.
• Webinar and virtual event production.
• Basic video and design skills for fast-turn social content.

Benefits

• Flexible PTO
• 2 Company-Wide Mental Health Days
• Parental Leave Programs
• 401(k) with Company Match
• Broad Equity Participation

Business Development & Corporate Growth

About ShadowObjects

ShadowObjects, LLC is a 20-year federal contractor with continuous delivery since 2006, delivering mission-focused technology, enterprise data solutions, and domain expertise across the Department of Defense, U.S. Navy, and civilian agencies.

Our Core Capabilities Include:

  • Enterprise Architecture & Portfolio Management
  • Data Engineering, Visualization & Enterprise Migration
  • Digital Transformation, Automation & Low-Code Integration
  • Enterprise Business Systems, ERP (Navy ERP) & Systems Integration
  • IT Service Management (ITSM), Cloud Operations & Program Management

Position Overview

ShadowObjects is seeking a results-driven Senior Proposal Manager to lead and scale our federal proposal development lifecycle. Reporting directly to the Chief Growth Officer, you will serve as the primary leader across full-lifecycle proposal operations—translating capture strategies, technical solutions, and customer insights into compliant, compelling, and winning proposals.

This is a high-impact Player-Coach role. You will independently manage complex prime and subcontract proposals ranging from approximately $5M to $100M+ in value while building and modernizing our corporate proposal engine with automated workflows, reusable content repositories, and AI-enabled tools.

Key Responsibilities

1. Full-Lifecycle Proposal Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end proposal operations from solicitation release (RFP/RFQ/RFI) through final submission, post-submission responses, and BAFO/FPR.
  • Establish and manage proposal schedules, compliance matrices, detailed outlines, resource assignments, and final production plans.
  • Facilitate structured kickoff meetings, proposal standups, and rigorous Pink, Red, Gold, and Executive review milestones.
  • Resolve schedule, compliance, staffing, pricing, and content risks early and decisively.

2. Strategy, Solutioning & Content Development

  • Partner with the CGO, Capture Managers, and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to translate capture strategies into discriminators, win themes, and customer-centric messaging.
  • Author and edit major proposal sections, including Executive Summaries, Technical Approaches, Management Approaches, Staffing & Key Personnel Plans, Quality Assurance, Transition Plans, and Past Performance.
  • Develop detailed Section L & M requirements traceability matrices and ensure compliance with solicitation instructions, evaluation criteria, and formatting rules.

3. Knowledge Management & Proposal Infrastructure

  • Build, organize, and maintain a centralized, scalable corporate proposal repository.
  • Integrate appropriate generative AI and workflow-automation tools to accelerate drafting cycles and improve content consistency.
  • Conduct post-submission lessons learned reviews to continuously improve proposal efficiency and increase win rates.

Performance Milestones & Expectations

First 90 Days

  • Master ShadowObjects’ contract vehicles, capabilities, past performance, and corporate differentiators.
  • Establish standardized proposal operating procedures, compliance templates, and review checklists.
  • Deploy an updated, centralized proposal content repository and begin active proposal leadership on current pipeline opportunities.

First 12 Months

  • Independently manage multiple concurrent prime and subcontractor pursuits across Navy/DoD and federal civilian customers.
  • Establish a scalable, repeatable proposal engine that increases qualified bid throughput while maintaining high-quality submissions and strong win performance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, English, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of dedicated federal proposal management experience; 10+ years strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex federal prime bids.
  • Expertise parsing and interpreting federal RFP Sections L & M, developing compliance matrices, and managing color-team reviews.
  • Exceptional ability to write and edit clear, persuasive, technically credible proposal narrative across multiple volumes.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), SharePoint, Adobe Acrobat, and collaborative proposal tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct Navy / DoD proposal experience, particularly NAVAIR, NAVWAR, Navy ERP, DASN(P), AIR 6.8, or related defense organizations.
  • Experience managing task orders and prime pursuits on vehicles such as 8(a) STARS III, OASIS+, GSA MAS, SEWP, CIO-SP3, or SeaPort-NxG.
  • APMP Foundation, Practitioner, or Shipley certification.
  • Familiarity with federal IT services, digital transformation, cloud migrations, and Deltek Costpoint environments.

Compensation & Benefits

Component

Offering

Base Salary

$155,000–$175,000

Annual Incentive

Performance-based annual bonus tied to proposal execution, knowledge management, and qualified contract awards

Sign-On

Sign-on incentives may be available for top candidates

Comprehensive 401(k) retirement plan with competitive corporate matching

Paid Time Off

15 days of annual PTO plus 11 paid holidays

Health & Wellness

Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage with significant employer contributions

Insurance

Company-paid Life, Short-Term Disability (STD), and Long-Term Disability (LTD)

Work Environment

Flexible Hybrid/Remote working arrangements with modern collaboration tools

Equal Opportunity Employer

ShadowObjects, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
Wer steckt hinter VANTOYA?

VANTOYA ist ein modernes Tax Venture aus München mit einer klaren Mission. Wir wollen Steuerberatung in Deutschland neu denken: digitaler, effizienter und zukunftsorientiert. Weg von verstaubten Prozessen, hin zu smarten Lösungen, die wirklich Mehrwert schaffen.

Unser Team wächst stetig und mit ihm die Ideen, Perspektiven und Möglichkeiten. Wir arbeiten von München aus und teilweise remote für einen schnell wachsenden Mandantenstamm. Was uns verbindet? Neugier, Teamgeist und der Anspruch, Dinge richtig gut zu machen.

Wir kombinieren fachliche Exzellenz mit moderner Technologie. Wir setzen schon heute auf digitale Tools, vernetzte Systeme und automatisierte Prozesse und entwickeln uns ständig weiter.

Wir suchen Menschen, die Lust haben, diesen Weg aktiv mitzugestalten, eigene Ideen einbringen und bestehende Abläufe hinterfragen, um gemeinsam die Kanzlei der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Aufgaben

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Bei Vantoya übernimmst du als (Junior) Tax Advisor Verantwortung für einen eigenen Mandantenstamm im Tandem mit einem/einer erfahrenen Steuerberater:in.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Du steuerst die ganzheitliche Betreuung des Mandantenstamms von Deklaration & Review (Jahresabschlüsse, Steuererklärungen, laufende FiBu) bis zu steuerstrategischen Fragestellungen
  • Du bist fachliche:r Sparringspartner:in und Mentor:in für die Tax Professionals in deinem Team inkl. freiwilligem Mentoring über Teamgrenzen hinweg
  • Du baust Mandantenbeziehungen aus und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns deine Positionierung als Steuerexpert:in weiter (inkl. Akquise)
  • Neben deinem fachlichen Alltag wirkst du in ausgewählten Projekten zu Themen wie u.a. Digitalisierung, Prozesse, People & Skills oder Organisation mit

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringen solltest:

Uns ist wichtig, dass es fachlich und menschlich passt.

Dein fachlicher Background:

  • Du bist Steuerberater:in und bringst 1-2 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit (idealerweise in einer mittelständischen Kanzlei)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV; idealerweise kennst du auch vorerfassende Tools
  • Du hast Praxis in FiBu, Steuererklärungen und Jahresabschlüssen und behältst auch bei mehreren Themen den Überblick
  • Akquise-Erfahrung ist willkommen, aber kein Muss
  • Du interessierst dich für Technologie, Digitalisierung und Innovation in der Steuerberatung

Deine Persönlichkeit:

  • Du bist serviceorientiert, kommunizierst klar und denkst unternehmerisch intern wie im Kontakt mit Mandant:innen
  • Du behältst den Überblick: priorisierst sauber und bringst Themen zuverlässig ins Ziel
  • Du hast Lust die Zukunft der Steuerberatung mitzugestalten mit hoher Einsatzbereitschaft, kreativen Impulsen und Veränderungsbereitschaft

Benefits

Warum Vantoya?

Unternehmerisches Umfeld & echter Gestaltungsspielraum

Du arbeitest mit Start‑ & Scale‑ups sowie anspruchsvollen Private Clients, trägst dazu bei, ihre unternehmerischen Ziele zu erreichen und hast die Freiheit, Dinge wirklich mitzuprägen.

Born Digital – im Alltag, nicht nur im Anspruch

Moderne Tools, digitale Prozesse, kein Papierstapel. Wir denken Steuerberatung neu, probieren Dinge aus und entwickeln unsere Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich weiter.

Entwicklung, die zu dir passt

Die Steuerberatung verändert sich und wir gestalten diesen Wandel aktiv. Gemeinsam schauen wir, wo du hinwillst, und unterstützen dich auf deinem Weg bis hin zu einer partnerähnlichen Rolle.

Ein Team, das sich wirklich unterstützt

Bei uns bist du ab Tag 1 Teil des Teams. Wir helfen uns gegenseitig, kommunizieren offen und arbeiten auf Augenhöhe, auch remote.

Arbeitsbedingungen, die zum Leben passen

Hybrid oder fully remote, flexible Arbeitszeiten, attraktives Gehalt und Benefits wie u.a. Wellpass, damit sich Arbeit gut anfühlt.

Lust loszulegen und mit uns zu wachsen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit deinem Lebenslauf, deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin, deinem Gehaltswunsch und optional deinen Zeugnissen. Zeig uns gern, was dich antreibt und warum VANTOYA für dich der richtige nächste Schritt ist.

Wir freuen uns dich kennenzulernen!

Overview

The Data & Insight Analyst is a mid-level position responsible for developing and supporting scalable analytics and reporting solutions that drive business decision-making. This role involves hands-on work with data integration, report development, and performance optimization across various data sources and BI tools. The Data & Insights Analyst collaborates closely with internal teams to translate business needs into actionable insights, supports automation efforts, and contributes to the improvement of data quality and reporting processes. This role requires strong technical skills, a problem-solving mindset, and a passion for turning data into meaningful information.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and optimize scalable analytics and reporting solutions using SQL, Hadoop, Hive, and BI tools like Power BI and Tableau.
  • Drive automation of reporting workflows and data processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and timely insights.
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) across data environments and reporting platforms, providing best practice guidance.
  • Identify, communicate, and help resolve data quality and reconciliation issues.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to address reporting questions and client-specific requests.
  • Assist in enhancing existing reporting tools and dashboards.
  • Lead development and optimization of complex, client-facing reports supporting strategic analysis.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Information Systems, or related quantitative/business field.
  • 5+ years in analytics, including 3+ years consulting and 3–5 years in data architecture.
  • Experience with Business Objects, Hadoop, Hive, and Python for big data processing and reporting.
  • Proficient in Excel, Tableau, and Power BI for data visualization and business intelligence.
  • Skilled in Oracle SQL Developer, advanced analytics, and statistical modeling.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills to identify trends and anomalies in data.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for conveying insights clearly.
  • Quick to learn new tools, data sets, and business concepts.
  • Effective team player with experience in cross-functional and matrix environments.
  • Strong time management skills; able to handle multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Trusted to handle confidential information with discretion.
  • Capable of working independently and collaboratively.

Cognitive/Metal Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Problem-solving and thinking critically.
  • Completing tasks independently.
  • Interpreting data.
  • Making timely decisions in the context of a workflow.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
  • Learning new tasks and completing tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity quota.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.

Base compensation ranges from $75,000 to $110,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

raw.description:
About Us:

BukuWarung is SEA’s fastest growing startup and we are building the digital infrastructure for 60 million MSMEs in Indonesia, enabling them to efficiently manage and grow their business, starting with digital bookkeeping, online storefront & payments. BukuWarung’s vision is to empower 60 million MSMEs in Indonesia to become financially aware and enable them to manage and grow their business using technology.

BukuWarung is backed by top tier VCs globally: Peter Thiel’s Valar Ventures, Goodwater Capital, Y-Combinator, AC Ventures, Quona Capital, East Ventures, Golden Gate Ventures, , Tanglin Venture Partners and strategic angel investors from Stripe, PayPal, Plaid, Grab, Gojek, Facebook, AirBnB, Fast, Mastercard etc.


Job Overview

We are looking for a Legal Associate (Litigation) to manage and support legal disputes, investigations, and contentious matters across the business. This role will be responsible for handling a wide range of cases, including fraud, employment disputes, regulatory issues, and other operational legal matters, while ensuring proper coordination with internal stakeholders and external counsel.

The role requires a hands-on legal professional who can analyze risks, manage cases end-to-end, and provide practical legal solutions in a fast-paced environment. You will also support legal documentation, regulatory engagement, and day-to-day legal matters to ensure the company remains compliant and well-protected from legal exposure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and support litigation, dispute, and investigation matters across the business, including civil, criminal, regulatory, and administrative cases.

  • Handle dispute-related matters involving merchant fraud, employee fraud, payment-related issues, lending-related issues, and other business operational disputes.

  • Assist in managing employment and industrial relations disputes, including internal investigations, disciplinary matters, employee misconduct cases, settlement discussions, and proceedings before relevant authorities or courts.

  • Respond to and coordinate on police summons, witness interviews, investigations, and other law enforcement-related matters, including preparing supporting documents and liaising with relevant internal teams.

  • Draft, review, and manage legal correspondence relating to disputes and investigations, including warning letters, demand letters, responses to claims, settlement communications, and official submissions to regulators or authorities.

  • Support the legal risk management process by identifying, assessing, and advising on contentious legal issues arising from payment and lending activities, and provide practical recommendations to mitigate potential exposure.

  • Assist in handling incidental legal cases, including competition law matters such as KPPU proceedings, as well as incidental civil, criminal, or regulatory matters that may arise from time to time.

  • Coordinate with and manage external counsel, including monitoring case strategy, timelines, deliverables, and legal spend.

  • Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including compliance, risk, fraud, HR, operations, and business teams, to gather facts, develop legal positions, and ensure consistent case handling.

  • Prepare case summaries, legal analyses, evidence, and internal updates for management and key stakeholders.

  • Monitor developments in litigation, dispute resolution, employment, fraud, competition, and financial services laws and regulations relevant to the company’s business.

  • Maintain proper documentation and case records, and ensure timely reporting and escalation of material legal disputes and risks.

  • Provide legal support across the organization based on company-wide priorities, particularly in high-urgency or high-impact situations.

  • Handle day-to-day legal matters including drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing various commercial and employment-related agreements such as NDAs, vendor and procurement contracts, consultancy agreements, and other basic non-strategic third-party agreements, as well as employment and industrial relations contracts, including overseeing and supporting the implementation of such agreements.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law from a reputable university in Indonesia

  • 5–7 years of solid experience, preferably from Jakarta’s prominent litigation law firms

  • PERADI License is mandatory

  • Additional certifications or other relevant legal certifications are highly preferred

  • Strong exposure to litigation, fraud cases, employment disputes, and regulatory matters

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

  • Agile, resilient, and willing to travel as required

  • Strong analytical thinking, sound legal judgment, and excellent communication skills

  • Highly responsible, detail-oriented, able to work independently, and comfortable in a fast-paced environment

  • Male candidate preferred

Mandatory Documents

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)

  • Diploma Certificate

  • Academic Transcript

  • PERADI License (and other certifications, if available)

raw.excerpt: The Company Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond.
raw.description:
The Company

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

The Senior Demand Generation Manager is responsible for driving sustainable long-term pipeline growth and market engagement across Versaterm’s portfolio of public safety solutions. This role leads high-complexity, cross-departmental initiatives through expertise and influence, and brings deep functional and technical mastery of demand generation. The Senior Demand Generation Manager frequently represents the marketing function in cross-departmental and external engagements, contributes directly to decisions that shape the direction of the area, mentors others, and actively champions Versaterm’s values across the teams and work they influence.

What You Do

  • Designs and plans targeted go-to-market programs to build brand awareness and generate and nurture leads through the sales and marketing funnel.
  • Owns the strategy and execution of demand generation programs that drive qualified pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Defines and develops new demand generation approaches, frameworks, and best practices that raise the standard across the function.
  • Leverages digital platforms to automate marketing activities, including webinars, and determines the most effective points of interaction (POI) for marketing campaigns.
  • Utilizes Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, customer information, and marketing automation platforms like Marketo and SFDC to create and deploy effective marketing campaigns.
  • Partners with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to guide messaging, positioning, and content strategy, ensuring go-to-market alignment, optimizing campaign performance, and supporting product launches and market expansion.
  • Drives the creative development of content and communications that support demand generation campaigns and customer engagement, and optimizes ROI by establishing KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure campaign effectiveness and inform decisions.
  • Leads high-complexity, cross-departmental initiatives, ensuring alignment and execution against company goals and growth objectives.
  • Manages demand generation program spend, recommending investments that maximize ROI and scalability.
  • Creates a rolling calendar of campaigns that align to Sales leadership and Product pipeline goals.
  • Delivers a consistent experience for the Sales team with campaigns that are fully developed with content, lists, decks, and enablement to execute to plan.
  • Represents the demand generation function in cross-departmental and external engagements and contributes directly to decisions that shape the direction of the area.
  • Mentors colleagues across Marketing and partner teams, driving a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, with deep, recognized expertise and authority in demand generation.
  • Proven success building and scaling demand generation programs in a high-growth SaaS environment.
  • Strong understanding of public safety or mission-driven technology markets is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence at all levels of the organization without direct authority.
  • Deep mastery of marketing automation, CRM, and analytics platforms (e.g., Marketo, SFDC), with experience establishing KPIs and reporting frameworks.
  • Exceptional communication, analytical, and mentoring skills, with a record of raising the standard for the function.

Note: Due to the nature of our work with public safety agencies, this position requires compliance with the FBI's Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy. Candidates must successfully pass a comprehensive, fingerprint-based background check. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on CJIS security requirements, please visit the FBI's CJIS Security Policy Resource Center.

Versaterm is committed to fair and equitable compensation that is competitive, consistent, and aligned with the value each role contributes to our organization. The starting salary for this position will be dependent upon many factors, such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience, education, training as well as internal equity, market data, and business needs. In addition to base salary and our comprehensive benefits offering, some roles may also be eligible for variable compensation such as incentive plans or discretionary performance bonuses.

AI is central to how Versaterm builds and delivers solutions for our customers. Within Talent Acquisition, we use AI-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, helping our team work more efficiently and spend more time connecting with great talent. AI supports our work, but all hiring and employment decisions are made by people.

Versaterm is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and a barrier-free workplace. Accommodations are available upon request throughout all stages of the recruitment process and apply to the terms and conditions of employment. For more information, please contact .

Professional education and experience requirements for the role include:

About the role

Help shape AI-accelerated development at Rise Internet. You'll partner with teams across the company to build web apps, applets, automations, and integrations, using tools such as Claude Code and Amp Code in your everyday work.

You'llbuild fornetwork and engineering, sales and marketing, customer support, and finance and operations, working with the systems and data behind a broadband operation. Our stack includes Postgres, MySQL, Kubernetes, and Python APIs. We value building andshipping overexpertise in any one tool.

You don't need to be an expert. You'll own delivery with guidance from the Principal Software Architect and senior technical leaders: regular code reviews, architecture support, and projects scoped to your experience. Senior technical leaders will review and approve production changes as you build experience.

What you'll do

Partner and build

  • Work directly with teams to understand their needs and help triage, scope, and prioritize requests with stakeholders.
  • Use AI coding tools to design and build custom solutions and integrations with existing platforms.

Own it from concept to completion

  • Take projects from an initial conversation through deployment and ongoing support.
  • Support what you ship: fix issues, answer user questions, and take part in an on-call rotation for production tools.
  • Test early, gather feedback from the people using what you build, and iterate.
  • With senior guidance,learnproduction safeguards: safe database changes, monitoring, and rollbacks.

Shape how we build

  • Help establish reliable AI-accelerated development practices, including infrastructure setup, deployment pipelines, testing, and evaluation.

Modernize

  • Maintain legacy code and help migrate scripts, spreadsheets, apps, and services to modern tools and infrastructure.

Communicate

  • Document what you build so others can use, maintain, and extend it.

What we're looking for

Required

  • A background in computer science, engineering, or AI, and at least one substantive project taken from concept to completion through coursework, personal work, an internship, or a job.
  • Strong project ownership: work autonomously toward a goal.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, tailored to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Working proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python or TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience using an agentic coding tool (Claude Code, Amp Code, Cursor, Codex) to solve real problems.
  • Working knowledge of APIs and integration: REST, webhooks, MCP (Model Context Protocol), authentication, and reading and applying other systems' documentation.
  • Working SQL and enough database fluency to wrangle the data a solution needs.
  • Proficiency with Git: branching, versioning, and maintaining parallel workstreams across multiple people and AI agents.
  • Ability to explain, debug, and independently verify code, including AI-generated code, so it stands up to peer review.
  • Familiarity with deployment and testing basics: containers, CI/CD, cloud platforms, and writing tests.

A plus

  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, AI, or a related field (not required).
  • Experience building with LLM APIs: prompting, tool calling, agents, RAG, or frameworks such as Google ADK orLangChain.
  • Experience with classical machine learning.
  • Experience building data pipelines.
  • Telco, ISP, or WISP background.
  • Hands-on cloud experience.

raw.title: IT Tech Support Specialist
raw.excerpt: Colure Health builds technology that amplifies the impact of real clinicians.
raw.description:
Colure Health builds technology that amplifies the impact of real clinicians. Our care platform blends intelligent automation with compassionate workflows, helping physicians stay connected to their patients and deliver better outcomes with less friction. We believe innovation should serve people, and we’re committed to creating tools that empower every provider to improve the health, experience, and quality of life of the communities they serve.

POSITION SUMMARY

The IT Technical Support Specialist keeps Colure Health’s people productive and secure. This role is the first point of contact for technology issues across the executive team, US staff and the international care team in the Philippines, Ecuador and Colombia. It manages devices, accounts and everyday systems, and applies the security controls that protect patient data. As Colure adds clinics and staff, this role will help build repeatable onboarding, offboarding and support processes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

End-User Support

  • Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 support by ticket, chat, phone and remote session for hardware, software, accounts, VoIP and connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot issues affecting care coordinators and enrollment staff, including softphones, headsets, CRM and platform access, and home-network problems, often across time zones.
  • Document resolutions and maintain the knowledge base and self-help guides.

Accounts and Access

  • Provision and deprovision user accounts, email, licenses and application access, in coordination with HR and in line with least-privilege principles.
  • Complete same-day access removal at offboarding and support periodic access reviews.
  • Administer password resets, MFA enrollment and single sign-on support.

Devices and Assets

  • Configure, enroll and maintain laptops and mobile devices in mobile device management (MDM), with encryption, screen lock and endpoint protection enforced.
  • Maintain the hardware and software asset inventory, including shipping, retrieval and secure wiping of devices.
  • Apply patches and updates, and track compliance with device security standards.

Systems and Security Support

  • Administer productivity and collaboration tools, such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, the phone system and video conferencing.
  • Support the Cybersecurity Specialist with phishing reports, alert triage, and evidence collection for audits.
  • Set up technology for new clinic locations, including workstations, printers, networking and peripherals, with vendor coordination as needed.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of IT help desk or desktop support experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Windows and macOS, Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, and an MDM platform such as Intune, Jamf or Kandji.
  • Comfortable supporting remote users, including some international users, by phone, chat and remote-access tools.
  • Understanding of basic networking (DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN) and of security practices such as MFA and encryption.
  • Clear, patient communication and strong documentation habits.
  • Ability to work a schedule that covers part of US Eastern Time business hours, with occasional after-hours support.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • CompTIA A+, Network+ or Security+, or Google IT Support certification.
  • Experience in a healthcare or other HIPAA-regulated environment.
  • Experience with ticketing systems such as Jira Service Management, Freshservice or Zendesk.
  • Experience with VoIP and contact-center platforms.
  • Conversational Spanish, to support team members in Ecuador and Colombia.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS

  • Within 90 days: documented onboarding and offboarding checklists and an accurate device inventory.
  • Ongoing: first-response and resolution times within agreed service levels, and same-day access removal for every departing workforce member.

PRIVACY, SECURITY AND CONDUCT

  • Completes HIPAA privacy and security training at hire and annually, and acknowledges Colure’s workforce confidentiality policies.
  • Accesses protected health information (PHI) only to the minimum necessary for assigned duties, using company-issued, managed devices and approved systems.
  • Reports suspected security incidents, privacy concerns or policy violations immediately to the Chief Technology Officer and the Chief People and Privacy Officer.
  • Satisfactory completion of a pre-employment background check, as permitted by applicable law, is a condition of employment.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND SCHEDULE

Remote work from a private, secure workspace within the United States, with a reliable high-speed internet connection. Scheduled shifts cover part of US Eastern Time business hours and may include occasional evening or weekend coverage. Occasional travel to support clinic setups. As a non-exempt position, all hours worked are recorded and overtime is paid in accordance with applicable law; overtime must be approved in advance.

COMPENSATION

The pay range for this position is $26.00 to $34.00 per hour. Final pay is based on skills, experience and location, and is set within the range. Benefits information will be provided during the interview process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Colure Health is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

ROLE MODIFICATION

This description reflects the principal duties of the position and is not an exhaustive list. The scope and role may be modified at any time by the Chief Executive Officer or the Chief Technology Officer when required. This description does not create a contract of employment; employment with Colure Health is at will.

About Purelogics:

Since 2006, Purelogics has been building world-class software solutions for healthcare organizations. We transform complex healthcare challenges into elegant, compliant technology solutions that improve patient outcomes and streamline operations.

We're looking for a Strategic Account Specialist to drive new logo acquisition in the healthcare sector, bringing innovative AI/ML solutions to organizations ready to revolutionize care delivery.

The Role

This is a hunter role focused on breaking into new healthcare accounts. You'll prospect, qualify, and close deals with health systems, payer organizations, digital health companies, and healthcare technology firms. You own the full sales cycle and have complete autonomy to build your territory.

Your sweet spot? Organizations that need custom software development, AI/ML innovation, or digital transformation to solve real healthcare problems.

What You'll Do

  • Hunt relentlessly: Identify and close new healthcare logos through outbound prospecting, networking, and relationship building
  • Speak healthcare: Navigate complex sales cycles with clinical, technical, and compliance stakeholders who expect you to understand their world
  • Champion AI/ML: Show how machine learning, predictive analytics, and AI solve real problems like reducing readmissions, automating clinical documentation, or improving diagnostic accuracy
  • Build pipeline: Generate qualified leads through cold outreach, LinkedIn, healthcare conferences (HIMSS, HLTH, ViVE), and industry connections
  • Partner internally: Work with our healthcare development and data science teams to scope projects and ensure HIPAA compliance
  • Crush quotas: Meet and exceed revenue targets with a new logo focus

What You Bring

3+ years selling healthcare IT, digital health, health tech SaaS, or healthcare consulting

AI/ML knowledge in healthcare: predictive models, NLP for clinical notes, computer vision for imaging, care coordination algorithms

Technical fluency: Comfortable discussing EHR integration (Epic, Cerner), HL7/FHIR, cloud platforms, and emerging healthcare tech

Regulatory savvy: Working knowledge of HIPAA, HITECH, and FDA software regulations

Hunter mentality: Proven track record of breaking into new healthcare accounts and navigating complex buying committees

Consultative approach: You solve clinical and operational problems, not just pitch products

Remote excellence: Self-motivated, organized, and effective in managing your territory independently

Communication skills: Translate tech for clinicians and clinical outcomes for executives

Bonus Points

  • Existing relationships with healthcare decision-makers
  • Experience selling AI/ML in healthcare settings
  • Knowledge of value-based care, population health, or social determinants of health
  • Healthcare CRM experience (HubSpot)
  • Understanding of healthcare interoperability and data exchange

Why You'll Love This

Uncapped earning potential with competitive OTE structure

Strong base salary reflecting your healthcare expertise

Generous PTO for true work-life balance

Work from anywhere in the USA

Career growth as an early member of our healthcare expansion, with a clear leadership path

Full support: Healthcare case studies, compliance docs, AI/ML use cases, and technical experts to help you win

Make an impact: Every deal you close helps improve patient care and transform healthcare delivery

Why This Matters

You're not selling software hours. You're connecting healthcare organizations with AI/ML solutions that predict patient deterioration, reduce clinician burnout, improve medication adherence, and make care more accessible.

Every new logo you bring creates real change in healthcare.

Ready to Join Us?

If you're a healthcare sales hunter who loves clinical conversations, understands AI's transformative power in healthcare, and wants to represent a company with nearly 20 years of proven healthcare innovation, we want to hear from you.

Send your resume and tell us about your best healthcare deal (the complex one where you had to navigate clinical workflows, address compliance concerns, and prove real patient impact) to:

Role Title: Law Student

Role Type: Contractor

Location: US-based (Remote)

micro1 is engaging Law Students to contribute their legal expertise to a high-impact project for a customer. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Review, analyze, and annotate complex U.S. legal documents to provide accurate, context-rich feedback and insights.

  3. Offer detailed cite-checking and Bluebook formatting for legal materials and submissions.
  4. Provide clear written explanations of nuanced legal concepts and reasoning processes.
  5. Evaluate and verify the legal accuracy of provided content, ensuring consistency and reliability.

  1. Pursuing or holding a degree from a T14 (Top 14) U.S. law school.
  2. Current law student enrolled in a U.S. law school; J.D. degree holders or U.S.-based lawyers/paralegals with relevant expertise are also encouraged to participate.
  3. Experience as an editor for a law review or legal journal is required for law students; similar editorial experience is highly valued for other contributors.
  4. Exceptional Bluebook proficiency and demonstrated cite-checking skills.
  5. Strong written and verbal communication abilities with particular care for clarity and detail.
  6. Proven ability to distill and explain complex legal issues concisely and accurately.
  7. U.S.-based with in-depth knowledge of U.S. legal systems, research methods, and legal writing conventions.

raw.description:
About Pave Bank:

Pave Bank is the world’s first programmable business bank. Built by the founders behind Monzo and BigPay, we are redefining global business banking by integrating programmable financial infrastructure with world-class client experiences.

About Client Success:

At Client Success, our mission is to ensure our clients extract the maximum value from our banking products and services— driving product adoption, retention, expansion, and overall Pave experience. You will be a critical voice for the client internally and a trusted advisor externally, contributing directly to the company’s growth and product evolution.

As a Client Success Associate, you will be on the front lines of our operational engine, ensuring our global clients extract maximum value from our banking products. This is a high-impact role focused on the day-to-day execution of client retention, product adoption, and operational excellence. You will act as a bridge between our clients and our internal teams, ensuring that our programmable banking solutions are implemented seamlessly and securely.

Key Responsibilities of Client Success Associate:

  • Operational Management: Design, implement, and optimize Client Success workflows to drive efficiency and data-driven decisions.

  • Revenue & Retention: Execute strategies to maximize Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and identify expansion opportunities (upsell/cross-sell) of the client portfolio.

  • Onboarding & Playbooks: Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing and build operational playbooks for client onboarding and long-term adoption.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the "voice of the customer" internally, working directly with Tech, Operations, and Compliance teams to prioritize client-critical initiatives and influence the product roadmap.

  • Risk & Compliance Integration: Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure all client activities and expansions align with regulatory standards in a complex banking environment.

  • Data Analysis: Monitor client usage patterns and health scores to make proactive operational and resourcing decisions.

  • Client Success Excellence: Design, implement, and optimize the Client Success workflow and strategies to drive efficiency and data-driven decisions. Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing and help build the playbooks for onboarding, adoption, and revenue generation.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 3+ years of progressive experience in Customer Relations, Client Success, Account Management, or a strategic client-facing role.

  • Sector Background: Proven track record in a complex Banking/ Digital Banking, FinTech, SaaS, or Software.

  • Operational & Compliance Knowledge: Hands-on experience working within Risk and Compliance frameworks to manage client portfolios safely.

  • Data & Analytics: Highly analytical and comfortable using data—such as financial projections and health scores—to drive operational results.

  • Global Mindset: Ability to manage international portfolios and work effectively across diverse, global teams.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence internal stakeholders and external client leaders.

  • Adaptability: Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where agility is key.

  • Languages: Fluent in English; any additional languages are considered a bonus.

What We Offer:

  • The opportunity to shape the future of programmable banking and define new standards for global business finance.

  • A mission-driven, diverse, and international team with deep domain expertise and a passion for innovation.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

  • Equity in the company—so you're aligned with our growth and success.

We are seeking a talented Revenue Operations Coordinator to join our team on a full-time, temporary basis for tentatively 3 to 5 months to support our Revenue Operations team during a key period.

This role leans heavily toward hands-on execution, process adherence, and data hygiene. We are looking for someone with a RevOps or BizOps background who genuinely enjoys keeping systems running smoothly, completing daily operational workflows, and supporting the team with reliable, task-focused execution.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: You have exceptional organizational skills and pay strict attention to data accuracy and process steps.
  • Analytical Mindset: You enjoy working with data, auditing sales pipeline numbers, and maintaining CRM integrity.
  • Strong Communicator: You communicate clearly and concisely across cross-functional teams and Slack channels.
  • Collaborative Team Player: You work effectively with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Finance to solve daily administrative requests.
  • Hyperproof Experience: Familiarity with Hyperproof or similar compliance/operations software is a strong plus.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Closed Won Deal Reviews

  • New Business: Verify signed deals against the order form, update Account, Opportunity, and Contact fields, send the deal overview to the SVP of sales, and move the deal to Closed Won.
  • Renewals, Upsells, & Churn: Update contract terms and pricing, confirm added products, ensure a renewal document is attached (even for $0 deals), and record negative ARR for churn.
  • Partner Deals: Manage indirect renewals, expansions, churns, and partner recruitment deals, confirming term dates with Finance or Partnerships.

  • Closed Lost Audits: Confirm that all Closed Lost deals contain a required Closed Lost Category, reason, and competitor.

  • Data Enrichment & Lead Routing: Enrich account data via ZoomInfo and route inbound leads to the correct sales rep.

Channel Monitoring & Request Triage

  • BizOps Request Triage: Acknowledge, sort, resolve, or route incoming requests from reps, ADRs, Marketing, and Partnerships.
  • Slack Monitoring: Actively monitor operations related team channels. Gather context on incoming requests, record updates, and close the loop with requesters.
  • Tool Outage Response: Confirm reported tool outages, post an update in operations related team channels, notify affected teams, and post resolution updates.

Reporting & Pipeline Audits

  • Ad Hoc Analysis: Perform one-off pipeline and funnel analyses for specific regions or segments (e.g., Europe).

Enablement

  • ADR Campaign Enablement: Create process guides and train ADRs on campaign workflows using ZoomInfo, Salesforce, and Gong.

raw.excerpt: Koyfin is a fast growing fintech company building a powerful, intuitive analytics platform used by financial advisors and individual investors to research ideas, manage portfolios, and grow their businesses.
raw.description:
Koyfin is a fast growing fintech company building a powerful, intuitive analytics platform used by financial advisors and individual investors to research ideas, manage portfolios, and grow their businesses. We believe every investor deserves world-class research tools without the complexity or price tag of legacy platforms.

Our impact so far:

🚀 One of the fastest-growing platforms for financial advisors, driven by product-led growth
🥇 Recognized by users as a top-rated investment solution on G2
🏆 Rated as the top research platform for user satisfaction in the Kitces survey, the largest survey in the advisor industry

Reporting to the Head of Sales, this is a from-scratch build. Koyfin has over 60,000 financial advisors using the platform, and over 800,000 registered users. Koyfin is standing up a GTM Engineer function for the first time to help the sales team improve the sales assist motion to the existing registered users. You’ll be working directly with the Head of Sales to build the systems, data, and messaging infrastructure the rest of the org runs on. We are looking for someone to support existing AEs, newly hired SDRs and the Head of Sales to run tests, build reporting and create efficiently run motions to reach aggressive goals.

This is a builder role, not a maintainer role. You'll be defining: a funnel, a lead-scoring model, a reporting layer, an outbound message library that does not yet exist, in a company that runs lean and expects you to own outcomes.

Compensation: The base salary range for this role is $115,000 to $135,000, plus a performance bonus of up to $25,000 per year tied to team pipeline and revenue goals, paid quarterly. The role also includes equity options and medical, dental, and vision coverage for eligible US employees. Final base salary will depend on experience, skills, and location.

What you'll own

CRM, systems & data (foundational)

  • Full ownership of HubSpot: administration, integrations, and data quality

  • Own and expand enrichment and automated workflows for new registrants and existing users (e.g., Clay, HubSpot workflows, API integrations)

  • Define and document the funnel from lead to deal created, including the lead-scoring model

Reporting & analytics

  • Build the dashboards, reporting, and forecasting infrastructure the org uses to judge whether a motion is working

  • Own test-validation tooling for time-boxed motion tests

Outbound messaging

  • Create and iterate all prospect-facing messaging across email and LinkedIn, working in tandem with the SDRs on targeting and sequencing

  • Own message performance (reply rates, positive-reply definition) as an input to the funnel data above

Partnership & process

  • Work alongside AEs and SDRs day to day to identify what’s working, iterate and improve

What we're looking for

  • 5–8+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM analytics

  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience (admin-level) or equivalent depth in a comparable CRM; comfortable owning integrations and data architecture, not just reporting on top of them (there is a full engineering team available on an as-needed basis)

  • Hands-on with enrichment and automation tooling (e.g., Clay, Zapier/n8n, APIs/webhooks); SQL or scripting a plus

  • Strong analytical skills with ability to build funnel definitions, lead-scoring models, and forecasting from scratch, without a data team behind you

  • Experience writing and iterating outbound sales copy (email and LinkedIn), or directly overseeing it, since this role owns messaging end to end here, not just the systems around it

  • Comfortable in ambiguity: this is a two-person function (you and the Head of Sales) inside a five-person sales org, and you'll be setting definitions and processes that don't currently exist

  • Fintech, financial data, or advisor-facing SaaS experience a plus, not required

Why Join Koyfin

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary, equity options, and a comprehensive benefits package

  • Innovative Environment: Be part of a fast-growing company at the forefront of financial technology, moving quickly to release new products

  • Dynamic Culture: Customer First, Humility & Respect, Teamwork, Continuous Improvement, and Getting Things Done

  • Impactful Work: Work with a small, talented team where your contributions directly impact the product and the community it serves

  • Industry-Leading Product: Join a company with an industry-leading product that is disrupting the financial analytics space through a product-led growth sales motion

  • Efficiency and Growth: Join a company that values efficiency, sustainable growth, and operational excellence. Koyfin is cash flow positive and emphasizes doing more with less

At Koyfin, impact comes with responsibility. We expect independent thinking, sound judgment, and ownership of outcomes. We value clear communication, intellectual honesty, and continuous improvement. You’ll be trusted to make decisions, contribute thoughtfully, and raise the standard of the work around you.

Our hiring process is thoughtful and efficient, typically including an HR conversation, role-specific interviews, and a final discussion with leadership.

Koyfin is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

raw.description:
Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and the Wirecutter). Our latest product is Calendar 2, which just launched to rave reviews.

Skylight’s mission is to build the OS of the family. We make consumer products, like Skylight Frame and Skylight Calendar, that are loved by millions of people across the globe. Through a singular focus on care for our customers, Skylight has scaled from a school project to over $300M in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped. We have a huge opportunity to make family life easier and more connected, and that’s why we have been working hard to expand our team.

We’re looking for a Director of Performance Marketing to own the core digital acquisition channels for Skylight Calendar. You’ll manage an eight-figure budget across channels like Meta, Google, TikTok and AppLovin. You’ll decide where the next dollar goes and build the testing and measurement program that tells us what’s really working. You’ll report to our Director of Growth and work closely with our creative, offline, influencer, ecommerce, brand, and retail teams. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who thinks in marginal dollars and maximizing ROI and is as comfortable in an ad account as in a contribution model.

What you’ll own

  • Channel performance and budget
    • Optimize spend across digital channels continuously, maximizing growth while hitting blended and channel-level CAC and contribution targets
    • Build monthly, quarterly and promotional spend plans (holiday, Mother’s Day, new launches) tied to revenue, inventory and margin goals
    • Design campaign structure for algorithmic performance; oversee optimization strategy and manage small teams to execute channel plans. Step in to support with hands on keys adjustments as needed.
    • Test new channels and tactics with clear hypotheses, success criteria and thresholds for scaling
  • Incrementality and measurement
    • Own the roadmap for digital incrementality testing (geo-holdouts, lift studies) to guide channel mix decisions, validate spend and open up new tactics
    • Reconcile platform reporting with incrementality, MMM and post-purchase survey data, and define which signals drive decisions
    • Understand halo effects: how digital spend drives sales at retail and on Amazon, not just DTC
    • Work with ecommerce to test funnels and optimize conversion rate.
  • Creative and testing
    • Work with the creative team, creative strategist, brand, and product marketing to set creative priorities and resourcing
    • Oversee a high-velocity creative testing program; support the Digital Performance Manager in balancing tradeoffs (velocity vs. quality)
    • Collaborate with marketing channel leads on testing roadmaps, including new audiences, messaging angles and offers
  • Leadership and communication
    • Lead and develop media buyers and analysts, and manage agency and platform partners
    • Explain performance clearly to leadership: what changed, why, and what we’ll do next

Requirements

  • 8+ years in performance marketing, with 3+ years in a growth leadership role at a consumer brand
  • Strong paid social and paid search competency at scale. Has managed an eight-figure annual budget across Meta, Google and at least one other channel, allocating spend based on marginal returns
  • Has designed and run incrementality tests and used MMM or causal measurement to make spend decisions.
  • Deep fluency in unit economics: CAC, MER, contribution margin, payback and LTV
  • Strong creative instincts, with the ability to turn performance data into briefs that produce winning ads
  • Strong technical understanding of signal infrastructure (e.g. pixels, Conversions API, server-side tracking and first-party data)
  • Comfortable pulling your own data (SQL or BI tools like Omni or Looker are a plus)
  • Bonus: omnichannel experience where digital spend supports retail, or experience with hardware plus subscription businesses

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • Competitive Salary + Equity Package
  • 401K matching
  • Wellness, learning, and home-office budgets
  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Excluding November, December, and January)

Equal opportunity employer

Skylight is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you’re the best person for the job, we want you on board!

We hire across the U.S., but for legal reasons, we have to list NY and CO separately.

For Colorado-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $180k - 210k based on experience and for California-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $180k - 210k based on experience. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of this law.

About BJAK

BJAK was founded on a simple belief: people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. That is where our name comes from.

We started in 2019 by building the region's first mobile-first insurance platform, making insurance accessible online to millions. Today we are Southeast Asia's leading insurance platform, and we are expanding into everything else people do with their money — spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling.

Our teams span more than 20 nationalities across our offices and remotely. We look for people who work for the thing itself rather than the hours, who want to build the next generation of products rather than maintain the current one, and who care about getting great financial tools into everyone's hands rather than a select few.

If that sounds like you, we would like to talk.

Why This Role Matters

We're not looking for someone to maintain relationships. We're looking for a builder who can turn partnerships into business growth. At BJAK, you'll own strategic insurer relationships, make things happen, move fast, and see your work translate into real business impact.

What You'll Build & Own

  • Own the partnerships. Build, grow, and strengthen relationships with leading insurers.

  • Spot untapped potential, pitch bold ideas, and turn them into commercially viable partnerships.

  • Close deals. Lead negotiations, secure commercial agreements.

  • Build from 0 to 1. Turn ideas into actual launches.

  • Drive growth. Own partnership performance, revenue targets, and commercial outcomes.

  • Solve problems. Break through roadblocks, challenge the status quo, and find ways to get things done.

  • Move fast. Take ownership from strategy to execution without waiting to be told what to do.

You'll Thrive Here If You…

  • You're a builder, not a coordinator.

  • You have a strong bias for action.

  • You own outcomes.

  • You think commercially.

  • You can influence and negotiate.

  • You're resourceful.

  • You thrive in ambiguity.

  • You want to build something big.

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or commercial roles. Insurance or financial services experience is a plus.

  • Proven ability to originate opportunities, negotiate deals, and deliver measurable results.

  • Strong commercial instincts, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple high-priority projects and drive execution independently.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup where priorities evolve and expectations are high.

  • Based in Malaysia and able to work on-site at our Petaling Jaya HQ.

We want someone who can walk into a room, spot an opportunity, win the partnership, and make it happen. If you need a playbook, this isn't the role. If you want to build one, let's talk.

The voice that turns a quiet client database into real conversations about buying or selling.

Fully remote

Contact list (previously used Follow Up Boss and RealGeeks), email, SMS/text platform, Facebook, Instagram

Role Overview

This role reactivates our client's existing database of past clients, referrals, and leads through email, text, and social media outreach — generating renewed interest in buying or selling a home. The Real Estate Sales Executive does not close deals; they generate and qualify interest, then hand off warm conversations to the agents for closing.

Key Responsibilities

Database Outreach & Reactivation

  • Send emails and text messages to contacts in the client's database to reopen the conversation about buying or selling
  • Track outreach activity: who was contacted, who responded, and who needs follow-up
  • Personalize outreach based on each contact's history (past client, old lead, referral)

Social Media Outreach

  • Reach out to relevant contacts via Facebook and Instagram messages
  • Identify and engage people showing buying or selling signals on social platforms
  • Keep messaging warm and personal — this is relationship reactivation, not cold advertising

Lead Qualification & Handoff

  • Identify when a contact shows genuine interest in buying or selling
  • Log conversation context clearly so the agents can pick it up without missing anything
  • Hand off qualified conversations promptly so momentum isn't lost

Tracking & Reporting

  • Keep a simple, current record of outreach activity and responses
  • Flag which messages get replies and which contacts are warming up

Who Will Succeed

This role is steady, repetitive, and relationship-driven. The person who thrives here doesn't get discouraged by silence or 'no' — they stay warm, consistent, and genuinely curious about people.

  • You're comfortable with repetitive outreach and don't take non-responses personally
  • You write and message in a natural, warm tone — never scripted or salesy
  • You're organized — nothing you send or hear back goes untracked
  • You're comfortable on social media and know how to message people without feeling like a stranger
  • You use AI tools to draft and personalize outreach faster, without losing the human touch
  • You know the difference between generating interest and closing a deal — and you're energized by the first part

    Experience & Skills
  • Required: Some familiarity with real estate concepts (buying/selling process, what a lead or database contact looks like) — not necessarily an expert
  • Required: Some experience with outreach, ISA (inside sales), or lead generation work — cold or warm outreach experience counts
  • Required: Strong written English — emails, texts, and DMs represent the client directly; writing is assessed at screening
  • Required: AI expertise — genuinely skilled with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) for drafting, personalizing, and speeding up outreach; this is a real capability, not casual use, and will be assessed
  • Required: Full overlap with Pacific Time required — not partial coordination
  • Required: Comfortable managing outreach across multiple channels (email, SMS, Facebook, Instagram) at once

raw.description:
The Director, Revenue Operations leads the Revenue Operations function, owning the technology, processes, data, and reporting that enable the Marketing, Sales, Channel, and Support organizations to operate efficiently and effectively. his role also serves as a core business planning partner, supporting channel and partner performance, quota and compensation planning, and pricing and packaging decisions.

Beyond designing and maintaining revenue systems, this role is a key business partner to leadership: analyzing pipeline health, sales performance, conversion, forecast accuracy, and customer trends, and translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. The role works closely with Marketing, Sales, and Support Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to ensure the organization has accurate data, effective processes, and the insights needed to achieve revenue goals.

Responsibilities
Revenue Strategy, Analytics & Insights
  • Serve as a strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Support, Finance, and executive leadership, providing data-driven insights and recommendations that drive revenue growth and operational efficiency.
  • Analyze revenue and customer data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance gaps by segment, geography, product, source, and sales representative.
  • Build and maintain dashboards covering pipeline generation and coverage, conversion rates, sales velocity, win/loss, bookings, retention, expansion, and forecast performance.
  • Define and monitor KPIs aligned with company objectives; analyze performance against targets and identify the drivers of over- or under-performance.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to analyze funnel performance and improve conversion, velocity, and revenue efficiency.
  • Conduct ad hoc analysis and modeling to answer key business questions and support planning and strategic decisions.
Forecasting & Pipeline Management
  • Own and continuously improve the revenue forecasting process, ensuring forecasts are accurate, consistent, and grounded in reliable data.
  • Analyze pipeline health, coverage, aging, velocity, and stage progression to flag stalled or at-risk opportunities and risks to revenue targets.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to understand forecast gaps and develop actionable plans to close them.
Business Planning & Go-to-Market Analysis
  • Analyze channel, partner, and distributor performance, including partner-sourced pipeline, partner productivity, and distributor sell-through, and recommend actions to grow the partner ecosystem.
  • Lead annual and quarterly quota setting, territory design, and sales capacity planning, aligned with the fiscal-year planning calendar.
  • Model, design, and administer sales compensation plans in partnership with Finance and HR, including analysis of plan cost, attainment distribution, and ramp policies for new hires.
  • Support pricing and packaging decisions with analysis of deal size, discounting, win rates, and competitive positioning.
  • Analyze product and license usage data (e.g., migration volumes and license utilization) to identify expansion, renewal, and churn signals.
Revenue Technology & Systems
  • Own the revenue technology roadmap and direct the administration of Salesforce.com and other revenue platforms (Marketo, Outreach, Microsoft Power BI, Zendesk), working hands-on where needed while delegating day-to-day administration.
  • Lead the design and implementation of new features, functionality, and processes; provide technical options and estimates for change requests.
  • Evaluate, deploy, and support technology solutions and integrations that improve productivity, data quality, and reporting.
  • Ensure systems capture the data needed for reporting, analysis, and forecasting, and document platform best practices to maintain data integrity.
Process & Operational Excellence
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Support Operations to deliver scalable solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline revenue processes, eliminate inefficiencies, and automate manual workflows.
  • Establish standardized definitions, methodologies, and data governance practices so revenue data is accurate, consistent, and reliable.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve revenue productivity, efficiency, and scalability.
Leadership & Communication
  • Lead, mentor, and develop the Revenue Operations team, which initially includes Salesforce/systems administration support, and shape the team’s structure and skill mix as the function grows, setting priorities aligned with company and revenue objectives.
  • Regularly present revenue performance, trends, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, translating data into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Balance multiple strategic initiatives with immediate business needs.
