raw.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video:
  • Our careers page:

Fleetio is entering an exciting new phase of growth. We've built innovative products across Maintenance, Fleet Intelligence, and our ecosystem, but product innovation alone isn't enough. Our next stage of growth depends on how effectively we commercialize those innovations and translate them into customer value, adoption, and revenue.

As the Director of Product Marketing, GTM Strategy, you'll build the operating system that connects Product, Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Customer Success, and Partnerships around bringing products to market.

This is a highly strategic, hands-on role responsible for creating the messaging, frameworks, sales plays, commercialization processes, and GTM operating rhythms that help Fleetio consistently launch, sell, and grow new products.

You’ll build the function from the ground up, and grow and lead a team focused on commercialization, GTM programs, and sales enablement.

Who you are

You're equal parts strategist, storyteller, operator, and builder.

You love turning complex products into simple customer stories that help sales teams win. You think beyond launches—you think about commercialization, adoption, pipeline, and revenue. You understand that great product marketing isn't about creating more assets. It's about building systems.

You've partnered closely with Product, Sales, Enablement, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive leadership to define positioning, create value messaging, develop repeatable sales motions, and improve how products reach the market.

You're comfortable creating the strategy yourself while also building the playbooks, messaging, presentations, and processes needed to make it real.

Most importantly, you're excited about building a function that doesn't exist today.

Your impact

GTM Strategy & Commercialization

  • Create repeatable frameworks that consistently bring new products to market.
  • Develop commercialization plans that align Product, Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Customer Success, and Partnerships.
  • Partner with Product leadership to ensure commercialization begins early in the product lifecycle, not at launch.
  • Establish scalable launch readiness processes that support both major launches and continuous product innovation.
  • Help shape pricing, packaging, and monetization strategies alongside Product, Finance, and Leadership.

Messaging, Positioning & Value Selling

  • Own Fleetio's corporate messaging framework and customer value narrative.
  • Develop positioning that shifts conversations from product features to business outcomes.
  • Create messaging frameworks for company, platform, products, industries, and strategic initiatives.
  • Build the First Call Deck and other foundational sales messaging used across the organization.
  • Develop solution narratives for key growth areas including Maintenance, AI, Fleet Intelligence, Telematics, and Partnerships.
  • Ensure messaging remains consistent across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Executive communications.

Sales Plays & Enablement

  • Build repeatable sales plays that help Sales create pipeline and win deals.
  • Partner closely with Sales Enablement to develop playbooks, talk tracks, discovery guides, objection handling, and value-selling content.
  • Integrate messaging into MEDDPICC and other sales methodologies.
  • Develop vertical messaging and industry-specific sales assets.
  • Build and maintain a centralized repository of GTM messaging, presentations, and commercialization assets.
  • Partner with field teams to continuously improve materials based on customer feedback.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Executive Leadership.
  • Build repeatable GTM planning rhythms across organizations.
  • Help teams align around priorities, milestones, launch plans, and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Demand Generation to ensure campaigns reinforce Fleetio's value narrative.
  • Support partner commercialization through joint messaging, enablement, and go-to-market programs.

Building the Function

  • Establish the commercialization function at Fleetio.
  • Define operating processes, templates, and best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to scale through AI, automation, and repeatable systems.
  • Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing commercialization team as Fleetio grows.
  • Create an environment focused on experimentation, learning, ownership, and measurable business impact.

Your experience

  • 10+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Go-to-Market Strategy, Commercialization, or Revenue Marketing within B2B SaaS.
  • Experience building commercialization, product marketing, or GTM programs from the ground up.
  • Strong expertise in positioning, messaging, value frameworks, and sales enablement.
  • Experience partnering directly with executive leadership, Product, Sales, Enablement, and Marketing.
  • Proven ability to translate product innovation into commercial success.
  • Experience creating repeatable GTM operating models and launch processes.
  • Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gong, Highspot (or similar), Notion, AI productivity tools, and modern GTM technology.
  • A builder's mindset—you enjoy creating structure where none exists and scaling teams over time.

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options

  • Professional development funds

  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend

About Us

BukuWarung is SEA's fastest-growing startup and we are building the digital infrastructure for 60 million MSMEs in Indonesia, enabling them to efficiently manage and grow their business — starting with digital bookkeeping, online storefront, and payments. BukuWarung's vision is to empower 60 million MSMEs in Indonesia to become financially aware and enable them to manage and grow their business using technology.

BukuWarung is backed by top-tier VCs globally: Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Goodwater Capital, Y-Combinator, AC Ventures, Quona Capital, East Ventures, Golden Gate Ventures, Rocketship.vc, Tanglin Venture Partners and strategic angel investors from Stripe, PayPal, Plaid, Grab, Gojek, Facebook, AirBnB, Fast, Mastercard, etc.

Role Overview:

Help get payment devices into the hands of merchants across Indonesia — one clean order at a time.

What you'll do:

  • Move orders out the door, cleanly. You'll be the bridge between what merchants order and what ships — turning our order data into the format our warehouse partner needs, with zero room for mistakes.
  • Own the inbound flow. When new devices arrive from suppliers, you're the person who logs them in, tracks every serial number, and keeps our records airtight from day one.

  • Be the connector. Work across Partnership, BD, Merchant Success, Marketing, and Product — plus our warehouse and 3PL partners over WhatsApp. Keep threads moving until issues are actually resolved.

What we're looking for:

  • 2–4 years in operations, warehouse, e-commerce, fintech, payment ops, or admin/billing roles
  • A track record of getting bulk data right the first time — you take pride in accuracy
  • Strong spreadsheet skills you actually trust (VLOOKUP, pivots, conditional formatting, CSV processing)
  • Solid written Indonesian; comfortable holding vendor and stakeholder conversations over email and WhatsApp
  • The kind of person who closes loops — when you say you'll follow up, you do
  • Ready to start immediately and commit through the contract

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

About the Role:

As a Senior Manager of Media Relations, you will help shape and amplify narratives around CrowdStrike’s products, business, and executives, driving high-impact earned media coverage that advances the company’s objectives and market position. This role reports to the Senior Director of Public Relations and Media Strategy. It requires a results-driven cybersecurity media relations specialist with deep industry knowledge, established relationships with top-tier media, and a proven ability to proactively develop and place compelling stories that resonate with customers, investors, and the broader market.


You’ll work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to identify newsworthy opportunities, develop differentiated narratives, and build relationships with influential reporters across cybersecurity, technology, business, and financial media. This is an opportunity to join a high-performing team trusted by executive leadership to play a key role in the company’s continued growth and market leadership.


What You’ll Do:


  • Develop and execute proactive media relations strategies that drive high-impact earned coverage aligned with CrowdStrike’s business objectives.

  • Strong news judgment and the ability to identify compelling stories, anticipate media interest, and turn complex industry developments into meaningful coverage.
  • Excellent writing and communication skills, with the ability to develop compelling pitches, executive briefing materials, and media messaging.

  • Experience working directly with senior executives and preparing them for high-profile media engagements.
  • A collaborative mindset, with experience working across marketing, communications, and technical teams.
  • High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Role Title: Medical Coding Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: United States, Remote

micro1 is engaging Medical Coding Specialists to contribute to a valued project focused on enhancing inpatient clinical coding accuracy and data quality. In this role, you’ll apply your facility coding expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Scope of Work

  1. Review inpatient medical records to ensure accurate ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS coding in line with current guidelines.
  2. Determine the principal and secondary diagnoses for the full admission and assess how MCCs, CCs, and procedures affect DRG assignment.
  3. Review clinical documentation for accuracy and completeness, and flag opportunities for provider queries.
  4. Evaluate AI-generated clinical notes, summaries, and code suggestions against real-world documentation and inpatient coding standards.
  5. Identify and resolve diagnosis and procedure coding discrepancies to protect data integrity.
  6. Enter and validate AI-generated patient information in inpatient medical record and encoder systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Active coding certification such as CIC, CCS, RHIA, or RHIT, or another AHIMA or AAPC coding credential.
  2. Inpatient ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS coding experience, including DRG, MCC/CC, and POA concepts.
  3. Access to current official ICD-10 code sets and guidelines, and familiarity with AHA Coding Clinic.
  4. Currently working in inpatient coding, clinical documentation improvement, or a closely related role.
  5. Availability of at least 10 hours per week.

Summary:

Sales Operations, Analytics & Business Performance

Sales Process, Systems & Operational Excellence

Overview

Vice President Sales - Provider

Drive Enterprise Growth. Shape the Future of Healthcare.

About Carenet Health

Carenet Health is a San Antonio based healthcare engagement company, and we are growing fast. For more than 30 years we have helped health plans, health systems and healthcare companies engage their members and patients at every step of their journey. Today we serve more than 500 clients, we have grown 500%, and we have delivered 18 straight years of profitability. We operate multiple nearshore and offshore locations alongside our U.S. teams. Our services span member and patient engagement, contact center and BPO services, clinical support and nurse advice, telehealth, advocacy and navigation, patient access and scheduling, and digital and AI-enabled engagement. With Invene and Orbita now part of Carenet, we also bring healthcare data, AI and conversational technology to the table.

Why This Role Exists

We are growing. 2027 is a step change for Carenet, and we are adding executive sales talent who open doors and keep opening them. We are making a real investment in this role, and in you. In return, we are looking for the best talent in the industry: sellers who build relationships every day. This role owns new logo and expansion growth with health systems and provider organizations.

The Engine Behind You

You will not be selling alone. Carenet has invested heavily in building a growth engine around every seller.

  • Marketing: A dedicated Marketing team, a refreshed brand and website, targeted campaigns and a calendar of industry events, all built to put you in front of the right buyers.
  • Sales Development: An SDR team that works with you 1:1 and provides outbound calling support on your accounts, with an expectation of at least 2 net new meetings per week on your calendar.
  • Deal support: Sales Engineering, executive sponsorship and a Deal Desk that helps you shape and win large pursuits.

Who We Are Looking For

Your network.

You already know the people who run patient access and patient experience at health systems. You have relationships with Chief Patient Experience Officers, VPs of Patient Access, revenue cycle leaders, CNOs, CMOs, Chief Digital Officers and population health leaders at health systems, physician groups and specialty organizations. These are people who see you as a leader and a champion of their business.

Your work ethic.

You have grit. You keep going through a long and demanding sales journey. You are always on offense: you build your own pipeline, you do not wait for leads, and you bring the next idea to the client before they ask. You are intellectually curious. You learn the client's business, the market and our solutions deeply enough to have a different conversation than everyone else in their inbox. You take ownership of your number and your word. You are a trusted advisor.

What You Will Do

  • Build and execute a territory plan across health systems, hospitals, physician groups, specialty practices, ambulatory surgery centers and MSOs.
  • Open new logos and expand within existing provider clients.
  • Build multi-threaded executive relationships, become the partner a health system calls before an RFP exists, and build account strategies for large clients.
  • Sell patient access and scheduling (including InQuicker), centralized scheduling, 24/7 nurse advice and triage, after-hours coverage, physician referral, post-discharge follow-up, patient concierge and digital front door and EHR patient portal support.
  • Use low-cost entry points to land, then expand across the patient journey.
  • Bring deals to Deal Desk early and shape the win strategy with the executive team.
  • Work with your SDR, Marketing and Sales Engineering to build pipeline through targeted campaigns and events.
  • Keep Salesforce and HubSpot current and forecast accurately every week.

How You Will Be Successful

  • Bookings (ACV) against an annual quota, set each year
  • Qualified pipeline created and coverage against your number
  • Executive meetings held with decision makers
  • Forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce and HubSpot
  • Growth of your relationships into multi-threaded account relationships

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of sales to health systems and provider organizations, with patient access, contact center, nurse triage or digital health solutions preferred
  • Experience selling to both clinical and operational leaders
  • Working knowledge of patient access, revenue cycle and EHR workflows (Epic preferred)
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • A track record of exceeding quota, with results you can show
  • Comfort running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including RFPs
  • Fluency with Salesforce, HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or the ability to get there fast

How We Hire

Our process looks at the whole picture: your talent, experience, network, relationships and account leadership. In your second interview, bring a written network plan: 25 named relationships at organizations in this segment, their title, how you know them, and how you would turn each into a first meeting. We will walk through it together. It tells us more than a resume.

Carenet Health is an equal opportunity employer.

Senior Content Marketing Manager

Today’s complex, fast-paced systems have become a minefield of reliability risks—any of which could cause an outage that costs millions and destroys customer confidence. That’s why high-availability teams use Gremlin to find and fix ‌reliability risks before they become incidents.

Gremlin Reliability Platform helps software teams proactively monitor and test their systems for common reliability risks, build and enforce reliability standards, and automate their reliability practices organization-wide. As the industry leader in Chaos Engineering and reliability testing, we work with hundreds of the world’s largest organizations where high availability is non-negotiable.

About the role of the Senior Content Marketing Manager

We’re looking for an experienced and dynamic Content Marketer to help drive our growth marketing strategy and execution for Gremlin.

Reporting into the VP of Marketing, you’ll be responsible for both advising on Gremlin’s content marketing strategy and owning launch, experimentation and improvement of Gremlin’s content across owned, earned and paid digital channels.

As Gremlin’s Senior Content Marketing Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to…

  • Own Gremlin’s SEO, AEO, and GEO strategy so we’re found and cited in Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity when engineers research reliability
  • Build and run an executive thought leadership program for our CEO and leadership team, including ghostwritten LinkedIn posts, bylines, and talk abstracts
  • Produce short- and long-form content for engineering leadership audiences: blogs, multi-format case studies, original research, and short-form video for social and sales
  • Tie content to pipeline: report on leads, pipeline, and revenue influenced, plus AI visibility (citations and share of voice on priority prompts), and shift effort toward what works
  • Manage content, design, and SEO/AEO agency partners, and decide what stays with vendors, what comes in-house, and what moves to AI-assisted workflows
  • Build and document repeatable AI content workflows for research, drafting, repurposing, and optimization, while owning technical accuracy and brand voice
  • Continually research, recommend, and evaluate new content strategies

As Gremlin’s Senior Content Marketing Manager, you’ll bring…

  • A strong understanding and passion for all things marketing
  • A deep understanding of the B2B technology buyer and their journey
  • A focus on business outcomes like pipeline and revenue influenced, not vanity metrics
  • Daily, hands-on use of AI tools that drive outcomes and keep quality high
  • Working knowledge of AEO/GEO and how AI search is changing content strategy
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • A willingness to fail-forward, learn and grow
  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS content marketing, ideally at a scaling SaaS startup

As Gremlin’s Senior Content Marketing Manager, you’ve seen success with…

  • Translating technical content into compelling copy and calls-to-action
  • Producing and editing written, video, and visual content, including short-form video for LinkedIn and YouTube
  • Owning and running content calendars
  • Driving content engagement through owned, earned and paid channels
  • Growing executives’ LinkedIn audiences, with numbers to show for it (follower growth, impressions, inbound podcast or speaking requests)

Die SIV.AG ist Teil der Harris-Gruppe und als einer der führenden Lösungspartner für die deutsche und internationale Energie- und Wasserwirtschaft, gestalten wir die Energie- und Wasserwirtschaft von morgen mit. Wenn du dich mit Engagement einbringen kannst, zögere nicht, dich bei uns zu bewerben. Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

If you are eager to sit at the intersection of law, technology, and AI-driven efficiency, we want to hear from you.

Why You Will (Or Won’t) Like Working Here

  • Real ownership early: You report directly to our Legal Counsel and work closely with them across the team’s full scope. The projects you take on are yours from start to finish.

  • Room to build: Many of our legal processes are still being optimized. You’ll decide how they should work and build the systems behind them.

  • Building and operating: Alongside the building, a large share of the job is recurring work: filings, deadlines, and audits that have to be done exactly right, every time. Your accuracy keeps Jerry in good standing in every jurisdiction, and people who enjoy both sides of the role do well here.

  • Growth that tracks results: You’ll learn from leaders who come from Amazon, Better, LinkedIn, McKinsey, BCG, and Bain. Promotion is based on performance and ownership alone, so strong work moves you forward fast.

  • Entity compliance: Keep Jerry’s corporate entities in good standing across the US and Canada, handling annual reports and state requests end to end on your own.

  • Brand protection: Monitor Jerry’s intellectual property, find infringements, and initiate cease-and-desist workflows.

raw.description:
Are you an accounting leader who is obsessed with AI?

We're looking for an experienced accountant who believes AI is going to fundamentally change how accounting gets done — and wants to be at the forefront of that transformation. Arboreal manages more than 10,000 apartments, and we've built our own property-management software platform, Maynard, with extensive APIs and MCP tools that let AI agents work directly in our accounting systems. This role is your chance to prove how much more a great accountant can accomplish when the manual work is handed to AI and the judgment stays with you.

The Role

This is a new kind of accounting role, built for how Arboreal intends to run its accounting function going forward. Rather than managing a team of people, the Accounting Manager oversees the accounting for a book of work primarily through AI agents operating on Maynard in conjunction with AppFolio. The focus is judgment and review: directing and supervising automated workflows, tackling complex reconciliations and investigations with AI, preparing and reviewing journal entries, validating what the agents produce, and standing behind the accuracy of the financials. You'll be one of four Accounting Managers who work side by side to make sure financials go out on time and accurately and that balances are reconciled across the portfolio. A shared pool of accountants performs a limited set of manual tasks and AI-assisted supporting reconciliations; these accountants do not report to this role. You'll have direct access to the CFO, the engineering team, and our AI-enabled accounting tools — and you'll be encouraged to experiment, improve processes, and figure out how much more is possible. This position reports directly to the Chief Financial Officer and spans accounts payable and receivable, corporate accounting, client onboarding and offboarding, and the review of property financials.

Oversee Accounting Through AI Agents & Automation

  • Own the accounting for an assigned book of work, executed primarily through AI agents running on Maynard alongside AppFolio — directing, supervising, and quality-controlling their output rather than performing each task by hand.
  • Use AI to tackle complex reconciliations, investigate accounting problems, and automate work that traditionally takes hours of manual effort.
  • Prepare and review journal entries and reconciliations, and review AI- and system-generated entries and reports for accuracy, completeness, proper coding, and compliance with U.S. GAAP before they are relied upon.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve exceptions the agents flag or that review surfaces, and determine when a human needs to step in.
  • Experiment with and improve agent workflows, prompts, rules, and controls — partnering with the CFO and engineering team so the system produces reliable results and keeps getting better.
  • Act as a knowledgeable check on automation — understanding what the agents are doing well enough to catch when an output is wrong, and never signing off on numbers that have not been verified.

Timely & Accurate Financial Reporting

  • Work alongside the other three Accounting Managers to ensure financial statements go out on time and accurately for the assigned portfolio each period.
  • Coordinate the close calendar and hand-offs across the manager group so there are no gaps or duplicated work, and so dependencies are met.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close and produce financials in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
  • Provide the CFO with variance explanations, supporting schedules, and management reporting for lenders, owners, and external tax preparers and auditors.

Reconciliations & Balance Integrity

  • Ensure balance-sheet accounts are reconciled and that balances are supported, reviewing the AI-assisted reconciliations prepared on the platform and by the accountant pool.
  • Confirm that AP and AR subledgers tie to the general ledger, and that cash, prepaids, accrued liabilities, intercompany, and interproperty balances are clean before financials are issued.
  • Investigate and clear aged, unapplied, or exception items, and document the resolution so it can be reviewed and audited.

Functional Areas Overseen

Across the following areas, the Accounting Manager owns the quality and timeliness of the work — exercised through the platform, the AI agents, and the shared accountant pool — and provides the review and sign-off:

  • Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable — oversight of invoice processing, payment runs, billings, receipts, and the related reconciliations, with controls over approvals, segregation of duties, and payment authorization.
  • Corporate Accounting — oversight of the management-company entities' close, including accruals, prepaids, intercompany activity, account reconciliations, and corporate financial statements.
  • Client Onboarding & Offboarding — oversight of the accounting workstream when properties and clients come on board or depart: opening balances, chart-of-accounts mapping and setup in AppFolio, final reconciliations, balance transfers, and clean handoff of records.
  • Property Financials Review — review of property financial statements for assigned portfolios before they reach owners, checking for abnormal balances, misclassifications, and unreconciled items.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance (or equivalent professional experience), and solid accounting experience with a strong grasp of general ledgers, reconciliations, and financial statements.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and U.S. accounting practices, including accruals, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Hands-on experience with AppFolio (property-management accounting) — transacting, configuring, and reporting within the platform.
  • Real enthusiasm for AI tools — Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar — and a belief that technology changes what an accountant can do.
  • An analytical mindset and willingness to learn SQL, APIs, and automation. You don't need to be a programmer — you do need to get excited about making a computer do something that used to take all afternoon.
  • Strong review judgment — able to look at an output and tell whether it's right, and to find the error when it isn't.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of complex accounting problems, and deliver results through systems and coordination rather than a direct-report team.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication and the ability to coordinate with a U.S.-based leadership team and peer managers.
  • Ability to work remotely from the Philippines with dependable internet and regular overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in U.S. property management, real estate, or multi-entity accounting environments.
  • CPA (Philippines or U.S.) or equivalent professional certification.
  • Experience with accounting automation, RPA, or AI tooling, or working on a proprietary or custom accounting system.
  • Experience onboarding new properties/entities or converting balances from a prior accounting system.
  • Comfort working across multiple AppFolio databases/tenants.

Engagement Terms

This is an independent contractor (1099) engagement, not an offer of employment. Services are provided remotely from the Philippines, and working hours are coordinated with the CFO to support timely month-end close and reporting. As an independent contractor, the individual is responsible for their own taxes and will provide a completed Form W-8BEN. Compensation and start date are addressed separately in the engagement letter.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Integration Developer to lead the design, implementation, and sustainment of secure data and application integrations supporting a large-scale Department of Defense (DoD) modernization effort. The Integration Developer will engineer RESTful APIs, ETL pipelines, and data validation routines that enable reliable and secure interoperability between enterprise systems, analytics environments, and external mission partners.

The position is responsible for optimizing data workflows, maintaining integration health, and ensuring information exchange remains compliant with DoD cybersecurity and data governance requirements across multiple impact levels (IL2–IL5).

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Integration Developer, Senior will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and data integration services connecting cloud-hosted applications, case management systems, and third-party solutions.
  • Implement and manage ETL pipelines for structured and unstructured data sources, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Develop data transformation, mapping, and reconciliation logic using scripting languages and integration frameworks.
  • Ensure interoperability through API gateway management, secure token handling, and encryption protocols (TLS, AES).
  • Perform data validation and quality assurance testing on integration transactions to ensure integrity across environments.
  • Collaborate with database administrators to design optimized schemas, stored procedures, and indexing strategies that enhance data access and performance.
  • Implement and monitor event-driven integrations using message queues or streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka, SNS/SQS).
  • Participate in Agile sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical reviews to ensure integration tasks align with program priorities.
  • Support sustainment and troubleshooting for data synchronization, latency, and connectivity issues across IL2–IL5 cloud tiers.
  • Work closely with cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with DoD RMF, STIG, and Zero Trust security principles.
  • Develop and maintain Interface Control Documents (ICDs), API specifications, and integration testing documentation.
  • Support post-deployment validation (PDV) and performance monitoring of integration services.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement:

  • Must hold an active Secret clearance.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Experience:

  • Minimum 7 years of experience developing and maintaining data integrations or middleware solutions.
  • Proven track record in API development, data migration, and system interoperability in secure, cloud-hosted environments.
  • Experience supporting large-scale federal or defense programs using Agile or DevSecOps methodologies.
  • Technical Knowledge:
  • Expertise in Python, Java, or C# for backend development.
  • Proficiency with API frameworks (FastAPI, Spring Boot, .NET Core) and data integration tools (AWS Glue, Talend, MuleSoft, or Apache NiFi).
  • Experience developing and securing RESTful APIs, web services, and data pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Familiarity with AWS GovCloud environments and related services (API Gateway, Lambda, S3, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD automation (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CodePipeline).
  • Knowledge of data security, encryption, and identity management (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
  • Understanding of performance tuning, load balancing, and API monitoring.

Certifications (Preferred):

  • AWS Certified Developer – Associate or Solutions Architect.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or equivalent DoD 8570 certification.
  • Certified Scrum Developer (CSD) or equivalent Agile certification.

Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills for integration challenges.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in Agile environments.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Ability to balance technical design and mission-driven outcomes.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Compensation: Anticipated salary range is $120,000.00–$125,000.00 per year.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Data Warehouse Engineer to join our team and work closely with clients to develop, optimize, and scale enterprise-grade data platforms, warehouses, and pipelines. We are looking for more than just a “Senior Data Warehouse Engineer,” but a highly skilled data technologist with strong communication and problem-solving abilities who thrives in cloud-based environments.

Contributions

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and architect the migration of data environments with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Design, implement, and optimize data warehouse solutions, ensuring best practices in data modeling, storage, and retrieval.
  • Ability to examine and understand complex data pipelines.
  • Assess, document, and analyze data sources, ETL workflows, and business intelligence tools.
  • Address technical inquiries related to data warehouse customization, integration, and enterprise architecture.
  • Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and ETL processes to support business intelligence and analytics.
  • Design and enforce data governance strategies, ensuring high data quality and compliance.
  • Work in an Agile development environment, collaborating with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the growth of our Data Exploitation Practice by implementing cutting-edge data warehousing solutions.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Ability to hold a position of public trust with the US government.
  • 5-7+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or data architecture.
  • Proficiency in Python or other object-oriented languages such as Scala, Java, or C++.
  • Experience designing and implementing data governance strategies.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with big data tools such as Hadoop, Spark, and Kafka.
  • Expertise in cloud-based data warehouse solutions, preferably AWS (Redshift, S3, RDS, Glue, Lambda).
  • Experience with Databricks, PySpark, SparkSQL preferred
  • Experience with ETL tools (SSIS or ADF preferred), data pipeline orchestration, and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Luigi, or AWS Step Functions.
  • Experience designing data models, schema design, and entity-relationship diagrams.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and database optimization techniques (Preferably SQL Server. Alternatively, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, a related technical discipline, or professional experience equivalent.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale data migration efforts.
  • Ability to work in a DevSecOps environment, applying CI/CD best practices.

About steampunk

Steampunk relies on several factors to determine salary, including but not limited to geographic location, contractual requirements, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. The projected compensation range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000. The estimate displayed represents a typical annual salary range for this position. Annual salary is just one aspect of Steampunk’s total compensation package for employees. Learn more about additional Steampunk benefits here.

As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Steampunk is a Change Agent in the Federal contracting industry, bringing new thinking to clients in the Homeland, Federal Civilian, Health and DoD sectors.  Through our Human-Centered delivery methodology, we are fundamentally changing the expectations our Federal clients have for true shared accountability in solving their toughest mission challenges.  As an employee owned company, we focus on investing in our employees to enable them to do the greatest work of their careers – and rewarding them for outstanding contributions to our growth. Overview

Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026!

Position Summary:

As a Senior Software Engineer in Test, you will be designing, developing, and maintaining complex software testing framework and tools. This position involves leading project, mentoring junior team members, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions.

Geo-Salary Information

An in-person interview may be required during the hiring process

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:

$94,458 to $179,048 (CA, NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$85,871 to $162,771 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$77,283 to $146,494 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.

In CA: Typical hiring range is $123,078 to $170,941

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Design, Develop and Maintain Test Automation Frameworks, Tools and Libraries: Develop a strong understanding of relevant product areas, independently implementing and maintaining complex automated tests and medium complex framework features.
  • Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills: Skilled in debugging and resolving simple blocking issues, especially with automation scripts, new frameworks and new tools. Applies analytical and creative approaches to tackle simple quality challenges with solutions.
  • Implement/Enhance Continuous Integration Continuous Deployment (CI / CD): Understanding of automation framework with CI/CD pipelines to facilitate automated testing during the build and deployment processes.
  • Performance Testing Support: Design and implement complex performance test script based on existing automation framework and tools to execute performance tests. Provide analytical and provide feedback for the releases in the test result report.
  • Define and Enforce Automation Standards and Best Practices: Enforcing coding standards, best practices, and guidelines for writing and maintaining automated scripts and framework. Review code written by team members to ensure adherence to standards and provide constructive feedback.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with cross functional teams and stakeholders to gather requirements and provide simple solutions in framework to meet medium-complex testing needs in small-medium sized team.
  • Create, Monitor and Analyze Test Results: Create, review and analyze test execution results, providing complex insights and simple recommendations based on findings.
  • Training and Mentorship: Train and mentor TE and SETs on using the automation framework to start writing medium automation tests. Training others to diagnose, resolve mid-complex issues and prepare proper documentation to ensure smooth operation.

Qualifications

Education:

Minimum:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or other related fields Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Experience:

Minimum:

  • 5+ yrs industry experience, independently implementing medium sized automation framework/tools

Preferred:

  • 3 or more years of development experience with Java and/or Python
  • 3 or more years of experience creating automation frameworks
  • 3 or more years of experience developing testing tools

Knowledge and Skills:

Minimum:

  • Familiar with the following:
    • Training, Leading, and Mentorship - Capability to train, lead and mentor junior team members in automation best practices and framework usage.
  • Knowledgeable of the following:
    • Framework Design and Development - Develop a strong understanding of relevant product areas, proficiency in designing and implementing high quality framework, that are modular, configurable, maximize reuse, are fast, effective, user friendly, secure, compliant, stable and maintainable.
    • Develop Testing Tools, Utilities - Develop a strong understanding of relevant product areas, integrate innovative tools, libraries, and technologies into the automation framework to enhance testing capabilities.
    • Create and Maintain Libraries - Proficiency in creating and maintain automated reusable libraries/components to enhance automated capabilities
    • Technologies - Experienced in containerization technologies. Experienced in cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure. Experienced in Leveraging DevSecOps to Improve Engineering Efficiency
    • Release Process and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) - Agile software development release process, CI/CD practices and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub) to integrate automated tests into the build process.
    • Performance Testing - Familiarity with performance testing concepts and tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner) to assess system behavior under load.
    • Documentation Skills - Proficiency in documenting framework architecture, components, usage instructions, presentation, and bug report, etc...
    • Requirements Analysis - Analyze [simple/complex] system requirements and design to determine the best approach for testing of the change/implementation.
    • Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills – Debugging and resolving blocking issues, especially in automation scripts, frameworks and tools. Applies analytical and creative approaches to tackle complex quality challenges with innovative solutions.
    • Collaboration and Communication - verbal and written communication skills on executing task-specific collaboration, conveying precise technical details, responding to immediate issues, and ensure clarity in resolving project-level technical challenges
    • Multi-Tasking Skill with Positive Attitude - Multi-Tasking skill with willingness and positive attitude to do whatever it takes to complete tasks on time or as quickly as possible.
    • Product Knowledge - Acquire and apply domain-specific knowledge to ensure that testing efforts align with business objectives and real-world use cases.
    • Test Automation Tools - Experience coding with popular test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, Appium, IDE, Metrics etc.). Knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
    • Debugging and Troubleshooting - Strong skills in diagnosing issues within the automation execution and scripts to ensure smooth operation.
    • Best Coding Practices - Ability to conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure quality and adherence to standards and best practice.
  • Experienced with the following:
    • Coding Skills - Strong knowledge of programming languages commonly used in automation, such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
    • Time Management - Excellent organizational skills to manage multiple testing projects, prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
    • Adaptability and Flexibility - adapt to changing requirements, code designs and implementation changes, new technologies, methods to solve problems, shift priorities, workstyle and responsibilities.
    • API Testing - Knowledge of API testing methodologies and tools (e.g., Postman, SoapUI, Curl, Insomnia) for validating RESTful and SOAP APIs.
    • Continuous Learning - Commitment to staying updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in test automation and quality assurance.
    • Attention to Detail - Meticulous attention to detail to ensure high-quality automated tests and reliable framework performance.

About the Company

Why choose a career at Mercury?

At Mercury, we have been guided by our purpose to help people reduce risk and overcome unexpected events for more than 60 years. We are one team with a common goal to help others. Everyone needs insurance and we can’t imagine a world without it.

Our team will encourage you to grow, make time to have fun, and work together to make great things happen. We embrace the strengths and values of each team member. We believe in having diverse perspectives where everyone is included, to serve customers from all walks of life.

We care about our people, and we mean it. We reward our talented professionals with a competitive salary, bonus potential, and a variety of benefits to help our team members reach their health, retirement, and professional goals.

Learn more about us here:

We offer many great benefits, including:

  • Engaging work environment
  • Promotional opportunities

  • Company recognition program
  • Health and wellbeing resources, including free mental wellbeing therapy/coaching sessions, child and eldercare resources, and more

Mercury Insurance is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Overview

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

The Incident Management role at HealthEdge is a multi-functional role working to support our hosted customers when incidents occur. 

Main responsibilities: 

  • Coordinate and manage our Major Incident process activities. 
  • Supporting Major Incident Management reporting (KPIs and customer SLAs) 
  • Drives standard execution of the Major Incident Management process 
  • Communicate with internal stakeholders and customer stakeholders as necessary about status, resolution, and success criteria signoff. 
  • Record and classify received Incidents and undertake an immediate effort to restore failed services while working towards the most efficient time to restoration 
  • Record all timelines, activities, resources, and assets involved in the Incident. 
  • Associate Incidents with other records (i.e. Incidents, Changes, Problems, Knowledge Articles, Known Errors, etc.) 
  • Partner with Problem Management on the RCA process and delegate information requests to technical resources involved in restoration of service. 
  • Create, define, and manage Technical Action Plans when major incidents occur. 
  • Work primarily is focused on Sev1 and Sev2 incidents, Problem Management partnership, Root Cause reviews and internal escalations. 
  • Collaboration skills and ability to work across technical and support teams. 

 

Requirements: 

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a major incident management role. 
  • Understands and has demonstrated the use of methods and techniques for the assessment and management of escalated incidents. 
  • Excel with communication skills (written and oral), with experience interacting across all levels of management and communicating issues with people, process and technology. 
  • Good understanding of ITSM processes within IT Operations 
  • Knowledge of how to support the Incident Management, Problem Management and Change Management processes while working escalated incidents 
  • Experience with utilizing Data Dog or other APM tools (AppDynamics, New Relic, Dynatrace, Solarwinds, etc.) to effectively triage issues and alerts
  • Understanding and ability to troubleshoot Hyper-converged infrastructure, Software Defined Networks, Hybrid cloud environments, AWS cloud environments, Virtualized environments, Unix and Windows operating systems 
  • Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills. 
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation  

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $115,000 to $130,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Mid-Level Developer (CMS) to support the design, development, and sustainment of a secure enterprise Case Management System (CMS) serving Department of Defense (DoD) stakeholders. The developer will contribute to building scalable, compliant, and mission-aligned features that enhance workflow automation, case tracking, and reporting across multiple cloud-hosted Impact Levels (IL2–IL5).

The Developer will collaborate closely with business analysts, senior engineers, and system architects to implement user stories, optimize data handling, and deliver iterative improvements through Agile development cycles.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Developer, Mid (CMS) will:

  • Develop and maintain CMS application components, ensuring seamless data flow and workflow automation across systems.
  • Support the implementation of microservices and API integrations that connect user interfaces, reporting dashboards, and backend data services.
  • Build secure, modular, and reusable software components within AWS GovCloud environments.
  • Collaborate with architects, UI/UX designers, and testers to refine user stories, define acceptance criteria, and deliver production-quality code.
  • Implement DevSecOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and version control through AWS CodeCommit or Git.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) and contribute to backlog refinement.
  • Apply DoD cybersecurity and coding standards, ensuring compliance with RMF and DISA STIG requirements.
  • Conduct code reviews, identify defects, and recommend performance enhancements.

Qualifications

  • Must hold an active Secret clearance.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in full-stack or enterprise software development.
  • Experience supporting Agile development and CI/CD delivery for federal or defense systems.
  • Demonstrated experience with case management or workflow-driven applications.

Technical Knowledge:

raw.title: Principal AI Engineer
raw.excerpt: About DrFirstFor 25 years, DrFirst has empowered providers and patients to achieve better health through intelligent medication management.
raw.description:
About DrFirst

For 25 years, DrFirst has empowered providers and patients to achieve better health through intelligent medication management. We improve healthcare workflows and help patients start and stay on therapy with end-to-end solutions that enhance prescription access, affordability, and adherence. Our solutions help 100 million patients a year and are used by more than 420,000 prescribers, 71,000 pharmacies, 270 EHRs and health information systems, and over 2,000 hospitals in the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a successful Healthcare IT company experiencing significant growth. Here you'll get to work with some of the smartest and most interesting people around; solving unique and complex challenges in healthcare on a scale matched by a few companies. If you get excited about stretching yourself in new ways, developing yourself to your fullest potential, care about working with smart colleagues; we want to talk to you!

Position Overview

DrFirst is building an agentic ecosystem at scale. In the last 90 days we have shipped production AI systems across HR, Finance, Legal, and Marketing, automating hundreds of hours of manual work monthly and delivering measurable business impact.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You architect and build production AI automation systems from discovery to deployment. You work directly with department leaders to map workflows and ship tools that augment their work.

The split is 80% individual-contributor engineering and 20% servant leadership and mentorship. You build. You own technical architecture decisions. As the team scales from 2 to 5-6 engineers over 18 months, you mentor through code review and pairing. You also teach non-technical department leaders how to use AI tools, translate technical concepts for executives, and run discovery sessions that extract workflows from stakeholders. Building stays your primary focus.

Who Will Love This Job

  • You are a senior IC who loves shipping code daily. You have been a Staff or Principal Engineer or led small teams, but you miss hands-on building.
  • You can architect multi-agent systems and run discovery sessions with department VPs to map their workflows.
  • You can debug OAuth2 flows through enterprise proxies and explain security requirements to non-technical stakeholders.
  • You are a servant leader. You remove blockers for others, teach through pairing rather than directives, and make stakeholders successful.
  • You organize chaos: 15 stakeholders, 6 systems, 3 sprints in flight. You ask “How can I help?” before “Here is what you should do.”

What you will work on

Build Production AI Automation (80%)

You own the technical implementation of department sprints. Example: an HR sprint delivered resume screening (40-candidate PDF extraction with table-of-contents parsing and fuzzy name matching), OKR coaching (Leapsome API integration with performance rating analytics), performance ratings (calibration detection across 328 employees), and milestone email automation in 4 weeks.

  • Architecture and Implementation: Design and build Python/FastAPI backends connecting to enterprise APIs (HRIS, ERP, CRM, finance systems, project management).
  • Frontend Development: Build Next.js/React frontends with Okta SSO, role-based access control, and audit trails.
  • Multi-Agent Systems: Design agent coordination systems, skill discovery hubs, agent registries, and workflow orchestration.
  • Enterprise Integration: Navigate Zscaler proxies, VPNs, SSL certificates, Kubernetes pod networking, DynamoDB, and AWS Bedrock.
  • Testing and Quality: Write Playwright end-to-end tests before production deploy and maintain a 1000+ test suite with visual regression baselines.
  • Deployment: Ship via GitLab CI/CD to AWS EKS (Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Helm, Secrets Manager) and diagnose pod restarts and liveness probe issues.
  • Async and Performance: Debug event loop blocking, convert synchronous I/O to async, and optimize CPU-bound operations.
  • Security: Partner with the CISO on PII/PHI de-identification, least privilege, and per-user OAuth2.
  • Production Support: Debug authentication flows, token expiration, API rate limits, and health check failures.

You will ship 3-5 production tools in parallel within each sprint, deploying multiple times per day based on stakeholder feedback.

Servant Leadership and Mentorship (20%)

Guide 2-3 engineers through code reviews and pairing. Teach department leaders how to use AI tools effectively. Translate technical decisions for non-technical executives. No direct reports and no performance reviews. Pure servant leadership.

  • Technical Mentorship: Code reviews, pairing sessions, and unblocking complex integrations.
  • Non-Technical Teaching: Run discovery sessions with department VPs, teach Finance/HR/Legal leaders how to prompt AI tools, and build interfaces non-technical users can modify.
  • Stakeholder Translation: Explain security trade-offs to executives and translate “OAuth2 delegation” into “everyone sees only their own data.”
  • Remove Blockers: Clear obstacles for team members, escalate infrastructure issues, and coordinate across departments.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Document patterns so others can self-serve and write playbooks department heads can follow without engineering help.

Daily Work

  • Morning sync with the VP of AI Automation on build queue, blockers, and technical decisions.
  • Direct coordination with 15+ stakeholders across departments.
  • Discovery sessions with department leaders to map workflows.
  • Hands-on coding: backend services, frontend components, and integration tests.
  • Security reviews with the CISO.
  • Ship multiple times per day and debug production issues.
  • Code reviews for 2-3 team members.

Qualifications

Required

Location: Remote UK based, able to travel to our Head Office in London and other operational sites around the UK when required

As Media & External Corporate Communications Manager, you will play a crucial role in managing a busy press office, media relations and issues management at the heart of the role. You will lead and support responses to complex and high-profile media enquiries, working across the business to protect Capita’s reputation. Alongside this, you will help proactively build our profile and communicate Capita’s transformation narrative to key external stakeholders through national media (including broadcast), regional press, trade press, owned social media and digital channels. Our clients and prospects are primarily public sector organisations, alongside some large private companies, and our work often directly affects the individuals and communities who rely on essential services.

You will report to our Head of External Communications and Marketing, and will work closely with our internal communications team, contract communications teams and marketing teams, as well as liaising closely with investor relations, public affairs and external communications agencies.

Successful candidates must have experience from a PR agency background and journalism.

At Capita, we live by our values: 🤝 Customer First, Always; 🧑‍💻 Fearless Innovation; ✅ Achieve Together; 💙 Everyone is Valued. These guide how we work, collaborate, and deliver exceptional results.

Job title:

What you’ll be doing

  • Managing and responding to daily media enquiries, often involving complex, high-profile or sensitive issues that affect individuals and communities.

Soft Skills

The Incident Response Analyst I is responsible for the initial analysis and classification of customer cases, as well as following troubleshooting documentation to quickly assess the customer situation and escalate if needed. The Incident Response Analyst I will also work with the customer through different types of media to provide a superior customer experience through tactical troubleshooting, monitoring, and proactive incident resolution for Flexential's customer environments. A strong combination of technical analysis, troubleshooting, documentation skills, and quick and friendly communication is vital to the Incident Response Analyst I role.

Key Responsibilities and Essential Job Functions

  • Provides initial analysis and triage for incoming customer calls, monitoring alerts, and customer-submitted tickets.
  • Establish friendly initial communications to customers to let them know we hear and understand the request/incident, and set concise and clear expectations regarding customer requests and incidents in a prompt manner.
  • Document resolution and proactive status updates to technical issues clearly for customers and team members.
  • Works closely with our Level 2 support team to stay current on technology trends and information technology concepts.
  • Collaborate with customers and teammates to determine improvement areas in capabilities and processes.
  • Resolve customer requests and incidents with a high sense of urgency and ownership.
  • Be a team player focused on collective improvement and growth.
  • Align to ITIL best practices.
  • Work in a high-paced environment where system administrators need to prioritize workloads.
  • Effectively work with vendors to create resolution.

Required Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of relevant operating systems (see below).
  • Attention to detail.
  • Good organization, time management, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and think critically.
  • Effective communication skills, including phone etiquette, writing, and active listening.
  • Great customer service skills.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Continually seeking new knowledge and curious by nature.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Positive attitude with a strong sense of urgency and ownership of quality work deliverables.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, System Administration, or a closely related field, or equivalent experience required.
  • 1-3 years of system administration, network administration, or database administration experience.
  • 2-3 years of customer service experience.
  • Network+, Security+, and/or CCNA desired.
  • Microsoft MCP or MCSA preferred.

PeopleSoft Integration Consultant - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: PeopleSoft Integration Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced PeopleSoft Integration Broker Developer to design, build, and operate enterprise integrations connecting PeopleSoft applications to internal systems, cloud applications, and third-party platforms. This role focuses specifically on the integration layer, including service operations, queues, routings, transformations, security configurations, and error handling. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on Integration Broker experience with broader PeopleTools knowledge and a strong understanding of API and integration design patterns. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integration scenarios using PeopleSoft Integration Broker, including service operations, queues, routings, and handlers.
  • Build synchronous and asynchronous integrations using REST and SOAP web services.
  • Develop transformations using XSLT, Application Engine, and PeopleCode handlers, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Configure security on inbound and outbound services, including WS-Security, OAuth2, and certificate-based authentication.
  • Build robust error-handling and retry mechanisms, including notifications, monitoring, and resubmission workflows.
  • Develop Component Interfaces and File Layouts to support hybrid integration scenarios.
  • Lead migration efforts to retire legacy point-to-point integrations to standardized Integration Broker patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.
  • Optimize performance of high-volume integrations through queue tuning, parallel processing, and asynchronous design.
  • Integrate PeopleSoft with cloud applications (Oracle Cloud, Workday, ServiceNow) and middleware (OIC, MuleSoft, Boomi).
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Provide hypercare and post-go-live support, including incident response and root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with functional consultants and integration architects, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PeopleSoft development experience, with a strong focus on Integration Broker.
  • Hands-on experience designing and developing REST and SOAP web services in PeopleSoft.
  • Solid PeopleCode and Application Engine experience.
  • Working knowledge of XML, XSLT, and JSON.
  • Experience with web service security standards (WS-Security, OAuth2).
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with the PeopleSoft data model.
  • Familiarity with middleware platforms (OIC, MuleSoft, Boomi) is a strong plus.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting PeopleSoft upgrades and patches.
Preferred Qualifications
  • PeopleSoft certifications.
  • Experience integrating with Oracle Cloud Applications.
  • Exposure to event-driven integration patterns.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tooling for PeopleSoft.
  • Strong understanding of API management concepts.
How to Apply

ABOUT US

Rythm is the fastest-growing lab in America. We redefined at-home testing with the world’s easiest blood test and created a culture around monthly lab testing from home. We’ve processed millions of tests across all 50 states, and we do everything in-house, from sample testing and logistics to code, marketing, and design. That vertical integration gives us the speed, control, and creativity to shape the future of health and wellness.

THE ROLE

As our Amazon Store Specialist, you'll own the day-to-day running and growth of Rythm's Amazon storefront — a channel that puts our at-home blood test in front of millions of shoppers already searching for health products.

This is a hands-on role for someone who knows Seller Central inside out and understands what makes an Amazon shopper click, trust, and buy. You'll work closely with our marketing, creative, and operations teams to turn listings, ads, and reviews into measurable revenue.

We're looking for someone analytical, detail-obsessed, and resourceful. You'll have real ownership of the channel and help shape how Rythm reaches new customers on the world's largest marketplace.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the day-to-day management, optimization, and growth of Rythm's Amazon store in Seller Central.
  • Build and maintain high-converting listings: titles, bullets, A+ Content, images, video, and Brand Store pages.
  • Run keyword research and SEO to improve organic rank and discoverability.
  • Plan, launch, and optimize Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display) against ACoS and TACoS targets.
  • Manage pricing, promotions, coupons, Lightning Deals, and Prime Day / Q4 event plans.
  • Monitor reviews, ratings, and customer questions; use Vine and other compliant programs to build social proof.
  • Partner with operations on FBA inventory planning, replenishment, and shipment creation to avoid stockouts.
  • Protect account health: policy compliance, Brand Registry, hijacker and counterfeit monitoring, and case management with Seller Support.
  • Keep listings and claims aligned with Amazon's health-product and restricted-category policies, working with our legal and regulatory teams.
  • Track and report weekly on sales, sessions, conversion rate, ad performance, and contribution margin.
  • Test new ideas continuously and stay current on Amazon platform changes and marketplace trends.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2–4+ years directly managing and growing an Amazon store for a consumer brand (1P or 3P), with hands-on Seller Central experience.
  • A track record of measurable revenue growth on Amazon — you can talk numbers.
  • Strong command of Amazon Ads, including campaign structure, bidding, and keyword harvesting.
  • Experience with listing optimization, A+ Content, Brand Store, and Brand Registry.
  • Working knowledge of FBA logistics, inventory planning, and account health management.
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable in Excel/Sheets and Amazon reporting (Business Reports, Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance).
  • Clear communication and the ability to work across marketing, creative, and operations.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and resourceful across many moving parts.
  • Thrives in a fast-moving environment and is comfortable figuring things out without a playbook.
  • Strong individual ownership, a low-ego mindset, and a willingness to do what it takes to get the job done.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Rythm Health offers a benefits package which includes:

  • A highly competitive base salary.
  • Meaningful equity aligned with the scope and impact of your role.
  • A monthly Rythm membership with full access to at-home blood testing and personalized health insights.
  • High ownership and visibility from day one, with the ability to make a meaningful impact.
  • The chance to help shape the future of personalized health and preventative care.
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment.
  • A generous paid time off policy.
  • 401(k).
  • Multiple healthcare plan options, with select plans fully covered by Rythm.
  • A small, collaborative, mission-driven team that moves quickly and values great ideas regardless of title.
