raw.description:
IGA Specialist – Microsoft Entra ID & MIM

Summary

We are seeking an experienced Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) professional to lead the strategic implementation and optimization of identity management solutions within our IT Services sector. In this pivotal role, you will design and manage robust access control frameworks, ensuring seamless integration between on-premises and cloud-based identity platforms. Your expertise will be critical in maintaining security compliance, automating complex identity workflows, and overseeing the lifecycle of user access across diverse environments. This position demands a deep understanding of modern identity protocols and the ability to translate business requirements into secure, scalable technical solutions that support organizational growth.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain the synchronization infrastructure connecting on-premises Active Directory with cloud environments using Microsoft Entra Connect and Cloud Sync.
  • Develop and deploy advanced automation scripts utilizing PowerShell, C# Rules Extensions, and SQL Server to manage complex identity logic and provisioning rules.
  • Design and enforce Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) models, conducting regular access reviews, certification campaigns, and segregation of duties (SoD) analysis to mitigate risk.
  • Implement and manage secure identity federation protocols, including SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SCIM, to facilitate seamless single sign-on experiences.
  • Leverage Microsoft Graph API, Azure Logic Apps, and Power Automate to build custom integrations and streamline identity operations.
  • Administer and optimize Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM 2016) and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Evaluate and integrate third-party identity platforms such as SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, and Okta to create a unified governance ecosystem.
  • Conduct continuous monitoring and auditing of access rights to ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulatory standards.

Requirements

Requirements:
  • Minimum of 6+ years of professional experience in identity management, specifically within the IT Services industry.
  • Proven expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Active Directory, and Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM 2016).
  • Strong proficiency in Active Directory, including hands-on experience with Entra Connect and Cloud Sync configurations.
  • Advanced scripting capabilities in PowerShell, C#, and SQL Server for creating custom rules extensions and automation workflows.
  • Deep knowledge of access governance principles, including RBAC, access reviews, certification processes, and SoD analysis.
  • Solid understanding of modern authentication and authorization standards, including SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SCIM.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Graph API, Azure Logic Apps, and Power Automate for building identity integrations.
  • Familiarity with leading IGA and privileged access management tools such as SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, or Okta.
  • Ability to operate within a salary range of ₹13-14 lpa, reflecting the seniority and technical depth required for this role.

As the Business Development Associate (BDA), you will partner with a National Sales Manager or National Sales Lead to execute account strategies, manage day-to-day customer needs, and ensure operational excellence across your portfolio. Working closely with Customer Service, Production, and cross-functional teams, you will help drive customer satisfaction, account growth, and the achievement of established sales and revenue goals.

Essential Job Functions:(The reason this job exists is to perform these functions. These functions are performed regularly, seriously impacts other jobs, and there are a limited number of employees whom performance of the function can be distributed.)

Strategy Execution & Campaign Management

  • Execute the account strategy set by the aligned National Sales Manager/Lead across assigned core and growth accounts.
  • Write storyboards and build campaigns that bring each account’s strategy to life.
  • Partner with the aligned National Sales Manager/Lead to build and maintain a call cadence, email cadence, and campaign schedule for each assigned account.
  • Execute outbound calls, emails, and campaign activity against the established cadence, in-house.
  • Organize and prioritize execution efforts by region.
  • Maintain account, order, and activity records in Bing Dynamics (CRM) to keep strategy execution visible and current.
  • Keep tabs on campaign success and report results back to the aligned National Sales Manager/Lead.
  • Make sure samples are sent to both the account’s own sales force and the end customer to support the strategy in market.

Communication & Cross-Functional Liaison

  • Communicate the account strategy internally to Customer Service and Multi-Line Representatives, and externally to the account’s own sales force (the customer) so everyone is executing against the same plan.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between Customer Service and National Sales, ensuring account issues are resolved and communicated back into the strategy.
  • Serve as the connecting line between Production and Sales, keeping both sides aligned on account needs and timelines.
  • Track orders to make sure they are moving along internally, looping in Customer Service and Order Entry as needed to resolve delays or issues.
  • Act as a problem solver and communicator across internal teams, and make sure everyday account meetings and functions are being carried out.
  • Loop in and coordinate with Multi-Line Representatives to support execution of the account strategy in the field.
  • Work hand in hand with the aligned National Sales Manager/Lead as an extension of their strategy, not a substitute for it.

Account Growth & Accountability

  • Co-manage the book of business with the aligned National Sales Manager/Lead and grow the account in conjunction with them.
  • Be tied to and held accountable for growth results on the core and growth accounts they support.
  • Support the growth of SMB growth accounts toward large core strategic account status for Bel Promo.
  • Flag account risk, opportunity, and order trends to the aligned National Sales Manager/Lead to inform ongoing strategy.

Essential Qualifications:(To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the competencies (minimum knowledge, skill, and ability) required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.)

Education/Certification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

Experience & Skills Required:

  • Prior experience as an Account Executive (AE), inside sales representative, or business development support role.
  • Strong organizational and execution skills; able to manage multiple cadences and campaigns across a regional book of accounts.
  • Working knowledge of Bing Dynamics (CRM) or comparable CRM systems for tracking account and order activity.
  • Strong written communication skills for building storyboards, campaigns, and email cadences.
  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with National Sales, Customer Service, and Multi-Line Representatives.
  • Comfortable operating in an in-house, phone- and email-based sales execution role.
  • Must be amenable to work on a graveyard shift

raw.description:
Привіт!

Шукаємо Product Manager’a, який будуватиме pipeline гіпотез, запускатиме A/B-тести, покращуватиме онбординг і конверсію в оплату, щоб разом з командою масштабуватиме цифрові продукти SubSub.

SubSub — це офіційний партнер YouTube, що допомагає медіакомпаніям та креаторам масштабуватися, монетизувати контент і будувати стабільний бізнес. Ми поєднуємо експертизу в медіа, власний продакшн і потужні SaaS-продукти.

Наші продукти:
📌 YouTube-аналітика 360° — аналітичний дашборд для глибокого розуміння ринку, зростання аудиторії та підвищення ефективності.
📌 Fan Funding — інструмент монетизації через підписки: публікуйте ексклюзивний контент, залучайте свою спільноту та отримуйте стабільний дохід.
📌 Live допоможе стрімити вже створений контент 24/7 на YouTube та Facebook.

Ця роль для тебе, якщо:

  • Ти не чекаєш інструкцій, а сам шукаєш можливості — нові шляхи, нові рішення.
  • Ти про бізнес орієнтованість: дивишся на цифри, розумієш юніт-економіку та обираєш рішення, що дають відчутний результат.
  • Тобі цікаво працювати в креативній індустрії — медіа, YouTube, блогери й діджитал-продукти тебе заряджають.
  • У тебе є амбіції: хочеш зростати, впливати на результат і бачити, як твої зусилля приносять реальні зміни

Твої майбутні задачі:

  • Можливість попрацювати з повним шляхом користувача від sign up до payment: виявляти, де втрачається цінність, і прибирати бар’єри (ICP/value prop/onboarding/pricing/quality).

  • Визначити activation як value realization, побудувати funnel + leading/lagging метрики й базовий дашборд.
  • Вести pipeline гіпотез, пріоритезувати під limited engineering, запускати й завершувати експерименти.
  • Робити A/B + швидкі тести: onboarding, paywall/trial, pricing/packaging, монетизаційні важелі.
  • Працювати з даними й інсайтами: сегменти/джерела трафіку + короткі юзер-дослідження (інтерв’ю/сесії).
  • Налаштувати growth cadence: weekly review метрик, беклог, експерименти, прозорий прогрес для CEO/маркетингу/інженерії.

Ми очікуємо, що ти маєш:

  • 4+ років досвіду PM у продукті (SaaS/subscription/freemium - плюс), бажано кейси freemium→paid / 0→1 revenue.
  • Сильний досвід growth funnel (activation/conversion/retention) і розуміння різниці між usage vs value.

  • Досвід A/B тестів end-to-end (гіпотеза → дизайн → аналіз → рішення), базове розуміння статистики/сигналу.

  • Упевнена робота з метриками та unit economics (CAC/LTV/churn/payback).

  • Аналітичні інструменти: Amplitude / GA4 / Tableau (або аналоги) + вміння формулювати події/трекінг.

  • Автономність, чітка пріоритизація, сильна комунікація зі стейкхолдерами, вміння писати структурно (Notion/Slides) і презентувати (Loom).

  • Рівень Англійської B2+

Твій комфорт має значення, тому ми пропонуємо:

💜 Здоров’я та добробут: покриття медичного страхування, доступ до корпоративного лікаря, сеанси масажу та психологічні послуги для підтримки ментального стану.

💜 Навчання та розвиток: покриття англійської мови та різноманітних тренінгів, щоб ви могли постійно вдосконалювати професійні навички.

💜 Активний спосіб життя: від йоги до боксу, від танців до мистецтва — ми організовуємо спортивні активності та творчі майстер-класи для підтримки енергії та натхнення.

💜 Гнучкий робочий простір: працюй там, де найзручніше — вдома чи в улюбленому коворкінгу, ми покриваємо витрати.

Ми любимо те, що створюємо, і шукаємо людей, які теж не можуть інакше ✨

Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

raw.title: Senior Director, Paid Search
raw.excerpt: About DarkroomDarkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow.
raw.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a Senior Director, Paid Search: the head of Darkroom’s Paid Search practice. This is an executive leadership role. You’ll own the strategy, performance, and commercial health of the practice across Google, YouTube, Microsoft Advertising, and the emerging AI search ecosystem (including platforms like Perplexity, OpenAI, Koah, and Kontext as their ad products launch), lead a team of Associate Directors, Paid Search Managers, and Specialists, and be accountable for the outcomes paid search delivers across Darkroom’s client portfolio.

The ideal candidate is a recognized expert in search buying behavior who has already built and run a paid search organization. You’ve scaled Google ad accounts well beyond $1M USD per month, led teams that include people managers, and served as a trusted strategic advisor to CMOs and founders. You’re curious about where AI search is heading and want to be the person who defines how Darkroom shows up there. You think in systems, not campaigns, and you know how to build a team that runs those systems well.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of Paid Media and sit on the Paid Media leadership team, partnering with Darkroom leadership on practice growth, margin, hiring, and the evolution of our service offering. You’ll collaborate closely with Paid Social, Programmatic, Creative, Analytics, Growth Strategy, and Shadow, and will be responsible for building the next generation of paid search leaders at Darkroom.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment for leaders who want to shape how a practice operates and grows. You’ll have the scope to define what best-in-class paid search looks like at Darkroom, at a moment when search itself is changing faster than it has in a decade.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and performance of Darkroom’s Paid Search practice, setting the direction across traditional search, Shopping, YouTube, and AI search.

  • Sit on the Paid Media leadership team and partner with the Managing Director on practice OKRs, annual planning, budgeting, and headcount.

  • Own the practice’s commercial health, including revenue, margin, client retention, account growth, and team utilization, and report on it to Darkroom leadership.

  • Shape Darkroom’s paid search service offering, defining scopes, pricing inputs, and new service lines, including how Darkroom packages AI search as it matures.

  • Lead Paid Search’s role in new business, partnering with the Growth team on pitches, audits, and proposals, and joining final-round pitches for key prospects.

  • Build, lead, and grow a team of 6+ across Associate Directors, Paid Search Managers, and Specialists, with Associate Directors and Specialists reporting directly to you.

  • Develop the practice’s leadership bench, coaching your Associate Directors into strong people managers, growing Specialists into future leaders, and building succession plans for every leadership seat.

  • Own the practice’s org design and hiring plan in partnership with Recruiting, from leveling and role definition to final hiring decisions on leadership roles.

  • Set career paths, leveling expectations, and the performance review process for the practice, and ensure every team member has an individualized growth plan.

  • Build a culture of accountability, craft, and candor where high performers want to stay and grow.

  • Serve as executive sponsor for Darkroom’s largest and most strategic Paid Search relationships, leading executive business reviews and annual planning with CMOs, founders, and leadership teams.

  • Act as the final escalation point for high-stakes client and performance issues, and own retention strategy for at-risk accounts across the practice.

  • Own key platform partner relationships with Google and Microsoft, securing beta access, support, and early insight for Darkroom clients.

  • Lead Darkroom’s AI search build-out, tracking and piloting new ad products as they launch, defining how the team tests them, and making Darkroom the go-to voice for clients on where search is heading.

  • Represent Darkroom’s paid search point of view externally through industry events, content, and partner programs.

  • Partner with Shadow’s product team to shape the AI and agentic tooling the practice runs on, and drive adoption so the team becomes more efficient and more effective at scale.

  • Set the standards for campaign architecture, bidding strategy, optimization frameworks, and testing methodology across a portfolio of 15+ accounts with aggregate monthly spend of $3M to $10M+.

  • Own the practice’s Shopping and Performance Max standards, including feed quality and Merchant Center best practices.

  • Define the creative standard for the practice, including ad copy, landing page alignment, and short-form video for YouTube, and make sure it’s applied consistently across every account.

  • Lead the practice’s measurement approach in partnership with Analytics, including attribution, incrementality testing, brand search cannibalization testing, and media mix modeling, and set the KPI framework (CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, and CPM) every account is held to.

  • Turn learnings from across the portfolio into repeatable playbooks, and stay close enough to the work to audit accounts, spot issues early, and lead by example.

What you’ll need to be successful:

  • 10+ years of paid media advertising experience, with at least 8+ years specializing in Paid Search and Google in particular.

  • 5+ years leading paid search teams, including 3+ years managing managers, with experience leading a team of 6+ in a fast-paced agency or in-house environment.

  • Proven experience building or scaling a paid search practice or department, including org design, hiring, process, and service delivery standards.

  • Experience owning or directly influencing a practice or department P&L, including revenue, margin, utilization, and pricing.

  • Track record of overseeing paid search portfolios at $3M+ in aggregate monthly spend, and of personally scaling Google ad accounts beyond $1M USD/month while maintaining or improving efficiency.

  • Executive presence with CMOs, founders, and internal leadership: ability to build trust, present strategic recommendations with confidence, and navigate complex stakeholder dynamics.

  • Expert-level command of Google Ads, including Shopping, Performance Max, and YouTube, and deep familiarity with Microsoft Advertising and the emerging AI search ad ecosystem.

  • Mastery of the e-commerce marketing funnel, from offer to ad to landing page to conversion.

  • Mastery of e-commerce performance metrics (CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, CPM) and modern measurement approaches, including incrementality and brand search cannibalization testing.

  • Strong background in portfolio-level budget forecasting, spend projection modeling, and data-derived decision-making.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex data into compelling insights for teams, clients, and Darkroom leadership.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.

Ciena's Wavelogic products advance high-speed optical fiber transmission through integrated analog technologies. This Analog Layout Engineer role contributes to advanced high-speed analog circuits in deep-submicron CMOS and BiCMOS technologies, including DAC, ADC, SERDES, transimpedance amplifier, modulator driver, and precision control and monitoring circuits. The role delivers high-performance analog layouts that enable broadband fiber-optic modem solutions.


How you will make an impact:


  • Evaluate layout feasibility for circuit designs in collaboration with senior analog designers, considering design trade-offs and team input.
  • Create layouts for assigned analog blocks through floor planning, placement, and routing.
  • Perform DRC, ANT, LVS, PERC, EM, and IR verification checks to confirm layout quality.
  • Investigate layout tool and process features that can enhance productivity.
  • Provide regular status updates, participate in team meetings, and share knowledge with the group.

The must haves:


  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • Custom analog and mixed-signal layout design using deep-submicron CMOS devices, including FinFET transistors.
  • Collaboration within an existing team environment and application of a constructive approach to team activities.
  • Communication and interpersonal skills applied in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Custom layout design of analog and mixed-signal designs, including ADC, DAC, PLL, and SERDES.
  • Utilization of industry-standard layout tools, including Cadence Virtuoso, Siemens Calibre, and Ansys Totem, and application of layout design flows for advanced technology nodes.

Nice to haves:

  • Scripting using PERL or SKILL.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.

Apply today to be considered!

We’re looking for independent contractor engagement (task-based - project-based).

  • Pay Rate: $14.00 USD per hour

  • Able to start within 48 hours

Why PPH?

Your language skills are the whole point — and this project pays for them

Apply once, get contacted directly when a spot opens — no chasing

Work from anywhere, on your own schedule, alongside any other work you do

Clear task specs, no ongoing oversight, no micromanagement

Real project experience with a global data and language services company

Work that actually improves how AI understands your language

Position Summary

Symetra is seeking a Compliance Analyst II to join the AML Compliance Department. This role supports the execution, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of the company's Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) compliance programs, including support for affiliated entities and subsidiaries.

The Compliance Analyst II plays a critical role in identifying, assessing, and mitigating financial crimes risks across the organization while partnering closely with business, operational, and compliance stakeholders to ensure adherence to applicable regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for an experienced AML professional with a strong insurance background, exposure to high-net-worth and foreign national customer risk, and a demonstrated ability to leverage data analytics and technology to drive risk-based compliance outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation and ongoing administration of AML and OFAC policies, procedures, controls, and monitoring activities in alignment with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  • Conduct AML and sanctions-related investigations, including alert reviews, customer due diligence assessments, sanctions screening reviews, and suspicious activity investigations.
  • Prepare and document investigative findings, including recommendations for escalation, referrals, or Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs), as appropriate.
  • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential financial crime risks using technology tools and reporting platforms.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners, including New Business, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk Management, Special Investigations, Investments, and Finance, to ensure compliance requirements are effectively integrated into business processes and system designs.
  • Provide guidance and subject matter expertise to first-line business teams regarding AML, OFAC, sanctions compliance, customer risk factors, red flags, and escalation protocols.
  • Support risk assessments, control evaluations, quality assurance reviews, and program effectiveness initiatives related to financial crimes compliance.
  • Participate in enterprise-wide and compliance-led projects involving regulatory change management, process improvements, data governance, automation initiatives, and technology enhancements.
  • Monitor emerging risks and regulatory developments that may impact AML and OFAC compliance programs.
  • Escalate identified compliance risks, control gaps, or potential regulatory violations in a timely manner, providing clear analysis and actionable recommendations.
  • Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of investigations, analyses, and compliance activities in accordance with regulatory and company requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, Criminal Justice, Compliance, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in AML, OFAC, sanctions, financial crimes compliance, or related regulatory compliance functions.
  • Experience supporting AML and OFAC programs within the insurance industry or another highly regulated financial services environment.
  • Knowledge of life insurance products and associated financial crimes risks.
  • Experience conducting AML investigations, sanctions screening reviews, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, risk assessments, controls testing, quality assurance reviews, and SAR filing activities.
  • Strong understanding of AML and sanctions regulations, including:
    • Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)
    • USA PATRIOT Act
    • FinCEN guidance
    • OFAC regulations
    • State insurance fraud and financial exploitation requirements
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing large datasets and utilizing technology-enabled tools to identify and assess financial crimes risks.
  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate complex compliance matters effectively to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • High degree of integrity, professionalism, discretion, and commitment to ethical decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with high-net-worth clients, foreign national customers, and enhanced due diligence programs.
  • Professional certification such as Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), Certified Financial Crime Specialist (CFCS), or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting technology transformation, data analytics, or compliance automation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with AML case management systems, sanctions screening platforms, and financial crimes monitoring tools.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including:
    • Excel
    • PowerPoint
    • Word
    • Teams
    • OneDrive
    • SharePoint
  • Experience with AML monitoring, investigations, sanctions screening, and case management systems preferred.
  • Ability to utilize data analytics and reporting tools to support risk identification and compliance monitoring activities.

Core Competencies

  • Financial Crimes Risk Management
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Investigation & Case Management
  • Data Analysis & Risk Assessment
  • Critical Thinking & Judgment
  • Communication & Collaboration
  • Process Improvement
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Ethical Decision-Making
  • Attention to Detail

This role offers the opportunity to help strengthen and evolve a growing AML and OFAC compliance program while partnering across the organization to proactively manage financial crimes risk and support regulatory compliance.
